jobs.title: AWS Devops Engineer with Healthcare Payer Exp.
jobs.description: AWS DevOps Engineer focused on application deployments, release engineering, automation, and production support in large SaaS environments. **Skills:** AWS, Ansible, Linux, Shell Scripting, Release Management, Application Deployments, DevOps Automation. **Duties:** * Manage application deployments, upgrades, and release activities. * Automate processes using Ansible and scripting. * Administer Linux environments and troubleshoot production issues. * Provision and support customer SaaS environments. * Drive automation and operational improvements. * Work directly with customers and internal teams. **Required:** * Healthcare Payer domain experience. * Strong AWS experience. * Hands\-on Ansible automation. * Linux administration expertise. * Shell scripting skills. * Experience with deployments, release management, and environment provisioning. * Strong troubleshooting and production support experience. **Desired:** * Python scripting. * SQL/PL\-SQL knowledge. * HealthRules Payer (HRP) experience. * Customer\-facing experience. * Candidates based in or able to support Pacific Time Zone hours.

jobs.title: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation
jobs.description: Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation assignments. * Grade forward deployed engineer engineering review solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Associate Forward Deployed Engineer — Workflow Evaluation work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Forward Deployed Engineer engineering review **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible. Remote · Independent specialist contractor. Employment type: CONTRACTOR. Applicants must be authorized to work from US. **Compensation** ---------------- Hourly rate confirmed after the interview process. **Application process** ----------------------- Apply through AuraOne's specialist intake for role\-specific routing and review. Final project scope, schedule, and contractor terms are confirmed before placement.

jobs.title: Clinical Product & Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered
jobs.description: Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered **Company:** M Systems **Location:** McKinney, Texas / Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time, depending on candidate experience and availability **Industry:** Healthcare Information Technology / Electronic Health Records (EHR) About M Systems M Systems develops healthcare information technology solutions for small and medium\-sized hospitals, including rural hospitals, emergency hospitals, and other healthcare organizations. Our platform supports a broad range of hospital functions, including clinical documentation, patient care workflows, behavioral health, operating room workflows, billing, accounting, and other healthcare management capabilities. We are seeking a nursing professional who can serve as the **clinical voice of the product** and work closely with our software engineering, product, implementation, compliance, management, and customer teams. Position Summary M Systems is seeking a **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager** to provide clinical domain expertise for our healthcare software products. **Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; qualified nursing students will also be considered.** We welcome candidates who are actively pursuing an ADN, BSN, or equivalent nursing qualification and who have strong clinical knowledge, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in healthcare technology. The successful candidate will help ensure that M Systems' EHR and clinical applications accurately support real\-world hospital workflows and meet applicable healthcare regulatory, compliance, usability, and product\-quality expectations. The individual will serve as a bridge between: * Nurses and physicians * Hospital administrators * Customers * Product management * Software developers * Quality assurance teams * Implementation teams * Compliance and certification organizations This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse or nursing student interested in combining **clinical knowledge, healthcare technology, software product management, compliance, and clinical informatics**. Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Product Management Serve as an internal clinical subject\-matter resource for M Systems' EHR and healthcare applications. Review product functionality from the perspective of nurses, physicians, and other hospital users. Help engineering and product teams understand real\-world clinical workflows and identify gaps between software functionality and actual clinical practice. Provide clinical input for new product features and product improvements. Participate in product planning and prioritization discussions. Translate clinical needs into clear software requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate whether proposed product functionality is clinically practical, safe, and easy for hospital staff to use. Clinical Workflow Expertise Provide domain expertise for workflows such as: * Patient registration * Admission * Transfer * Discharge * Nursing assessment * Vital signs * Clinical documentation * Nursing notes * Physician notes * Medication workflows * Medication administration * Physician orders * Nursing orders * Allergies * Problem lists * Patient history * Care plans * Laboratory results * Diagnostic results * Clinical alerts * Behavioral health workflows * Operating room workflows * Emergency department workflows * Clinical handoffs * Patient discharge instructions * Follow\-up care * Patient\-safety workflows Work with customers and internal teams to understand variations in workflow between different hospitals and care environments. Product Testing \& Clinical Validation Develop and execute realistic clinical test scenarios for M Systems applications. Test software using patient\-care scenarios similar to those encountered in hospitals. Perform: * Functional testing * Clinical workflow testing * User acceptance testing * Regression testing * End\-to\-end workflow testing * Usability testing * Patient\-safety\-related testing * Release validation Create detailed clinical test cases and expected results. Document software defects, workflow issues, usability problems, and clinical concerns. Work directly with software engineers to reproduce problems. Verify fixes after engineering changes are completed. Participate in software release reviews and confirm that major clinical workflows have been appropriately tested before release. Develop regression test suites for critical clinical functions. Clinical Quality Assurance Help establish a structured clinical quality assurance process for M Systems products. Create repeatable testing procedures for clinical modules. Maintain traceability between: * Clinical requirements * Product requirements * Regulatory requirements * Software functionality * Test cases * Test results * Defects * Corrective actions Identify high\-risk clinical workflows that require additional testing. Help establish release\-readiness criteria for clinical functionality owledge or willingness to learn the following is desirable: * Electronic Health Records * Microsoft Office * Microsoft Excel * Software testing * Defect tracking * JIRA or similar tools * Clinical workflow documentation * HL7 * FHIR * USCDI * Healthcare interoperability * Healthcare terminology * Clinical coding concepts * Healthcare privacy and security Key Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: * Clinically knowledgeable * Detail\-oriented * Analytical * Organized * Patient\-safety focused * Comfortable using technology * Curious about how healthcare software works * Able to identify workflow problems * Comfortable communicating with software developers * Comfortable working with nurses and physicians * Able to communicate with hospital administrators * Willing to research healthcare regulations * Able to maintain detailed compliance documentation * Interested in healthcare technology and clinical informatics * Comfortable working in a growing organization The candidate should also be comfortable questioning workflows that do not make clinical sense and clearly explaining why a workflow should be changed. Initial Priorities During the initial phase of the role, the Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager will focus on: * Learning the complete M Systems clinical product suite. * Documenting major clinical workflows. * Creating standardized clinical test scenarios. * Performing end\-to\-end testing of key EHR workflows. * Identifying functional and clinical usability gaps. * Establishing a structured clinical QA process. * Building a compliance and certification requirements matrix. * Identifying certification\-readiness gaps. * Creating clinical product documentation. * Supporting customer workflow discussions and demonstrations. Key Performance Objectives Success in this role will include: * Establishing a structured clinical product testing process * Developing comprehensive clinical test scenarios * Improving product usability for clinicians * Identifying workflow issues before customers encounter them * Reducing clinical defects found after software releases * Maintaining clear product and clinical documentation * Establishing a compliance and certification roadmap * Improving traceability between requirements and testing * Providing clear clinical requirements to engineering * Improving communication between clinicians and engineering * Supporting successful hospital implementations * Improving clinical product demonstrations * Supporting certification\-readiness activities Career Growth This role can provide significant career growth for a nursing professional interested in healthcare technology. Possible career progression may include: **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager → Senior Clinical Product Manager → Director of Clinical Informatics / Clinical Product \& Compliance → Clinical Informatics Leadership** The position provides hands\-on exposure to healthcare software design, engineering, compliance, interoperability, customer implementation, and product strategy. Why Join M Systems? This is an opportunity for an RN or nursing student interested in building a career at the intersection of **healthcare and technology**. Instead of only using an EHR system, you will have an opportunity to help **design, test, validate, improve, and shape the EHR itself**. You will work directly with software engineers, healthcare professionals, customers, and company leadership. Your clinical knowledge will influence how M Systems products are designed and how nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals interact with the system. For a nursing student interested in healthcare technology, clinical informatics, product management, or healthcare IT, this role can provide practical experience that is difficult to obtain through a traditional nursing position alone. Pay: Up to $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in McKinney, TX 75070

jobs.title: Controls Engineer Co-op (Spring 2027)
jobs.description: Powerex\-Iwata Air Technology Inc. As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. Come join a team where People make the difference! As a part of Marmon Holdings, Inc., a highly decentralized organization, we rely heavily on people with the aptitude, attitude, and entrepreneurial spirit to drive our success, and we're committed to attracting and retaining top talent. Position Description: As the Controls Engineering Co\-op at Powerex, Inc. you will have the opportunity to support the engineering group. You will work with mechanical and electrical engineers of diverse backgrounds to develop solutions to manufacturing issues and design new products. Engineers with experience levels ranging from recent graduates to 30\+ years of experience will support you as you develop design skills including PLC, Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) and Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) programming, problem\-solving ability, insight into different types of engineering roles, and gain experience with the design process. The project\-based approach to this co\-op will allow you to contribute to ongoing development projects and perform product line maintenance. As a co\-op onsite at Powerex you will work in an office, engineering lab, and assembly line/manufacturing environments. To be successful in this co\-op you will need to be open to a variety of activities that support the engineering team and embrace new challenges that will come as you gain experience. Example tasks based on co\-op experience level are below. * First Term Assignments: + Supporting team members in creating job packets for Production to build orders. + Assisting team members in the creation and maintenance of engineering drawings. + Assisting team members in resolving issues on the Production floor. + Programming HMI’s to add new functionality. * Second Term Assignments: + Design and implementation of small projects intended to improve the existing line of products. Various projects are available for assignment progressing in difficulty. + Executing and implementing Engineering Change Notices. + Learn start\-of\-the\-art ePlan design software. * Third Term Assignments: + Participation in New Product Development projects. This includes concept ideation, design, prototyping, and testing along with production implementation. + Design and implementation of more complex sustaining projects intended to improve the existing line of products. These may include significant product enhancements and quality improvements with a higher level of difficulty required for successful completion. **Qualifications** * Minimum of 1\-year engineering focused higher education completed at start of co\-op. * Minimum 3\.0 GPA * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite * Ability to work independently and in teams. * Electrical aptitude with a passion for designing systems with HMI’s and PLC’s. * Experience with basic laboratory electronic equipment (oscilloscopes, signal generators, power supplies, multimeters, etc.) preferred **Company Description:** Hospital breathing air, laboratory nitrogen generators, bus kneeling capability, and many other applications require clean, dry, compressed air. Since 1988, Powerex has focused on designing and manufacturing reliable systems that supply compressed air and vacuum for these markets at the best value. Powerex has a full in\-house engineering staff, which allows for the customization of systems and the development innovative new products to meet the needs of customers and changing markets. Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job\-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (AWS, Spark)
jobs.description: At Peregrine Advisors, you will build the pipelines that move a federal agency's data from source to platform. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will learn new systems and tools, take on greater responsibility, and help develop the firm's capabilities, tools, and lines of business. We move our best to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $103,000 to $140,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public. **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you building ingest, processing, and storage at scale. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build Spark\-based extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines with Glue, Amazon EMR, Lambda, and Step Functions. * Write the processing in Python and PySpark. * Design the S3 layer, including Parquet, partitioning, and lifecycle, feeding Apache Iceberg tables. * Connect PostgreSQL on Amazon Aurora and DynamoDB, with Trino for federated Structured Query Language (SQL) across them. You deliver pipelines that keep data clean and trustworthy at the volumes a federal platform runs at. You automate ingestion that used to be handled case by case, and you build the storage design everything downstream depends on. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of data engineering experience * Bachelor's degree * Spark ETL on AWS (Glue, Amazon EMR) in Python and PySpark * S3 data\-lake design (Parquet, partitioning, lifecycle) feeding Apache Iceberg tables, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB * Event orchestration (Lambda, Step Functions, SQS/SNS) with secrets management and monitoring * Data quality, validation, and lineage * Infrastructure\-as\-code (CloudFormation or Terraform) * Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Master's degree in a relevant field * Trino or comparable federated SQL across the lake and relational stores * Apache Ranger\-governed access * Legacy ETL migration (for example DataStage) * Federal information technology or high\-volume data experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You are a data engineer who wants to get better at it, and you know which parts you have not mastered yet. You care as much about whether the data is trustworthy as whether it arrives, and you do your best work alongside people who push you. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on data engineering on AWS: Spark ETL (Glue, EMR), Python and PySpark, and S3 data\-lake design feeding the platform stores. * The reliability craft around it: event orchestration, data quality and lineage, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * The judgment to build in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: Founding Marketer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You own how MintMCP grows. Turn heavy inbound into measurable, repeatable pipeline across both motions: self\-serve, where an engineer tries the gateway, and sales\-assisted, where security review turns into a company\-wide deal. You own positioning for a technical buyer and demand gen across SEO, AEO, paid, and content. You run a webinar series and a steady stream of campaign experiments, build outbound from the ground up with the AE team, and own the lifecycle that turns signups, trials, and security reviews into pipeline. You also own the numbers: how every channel performs, CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. What makes this different is how you do it. You will not run every campaign by hand, and you will not wait to hire a team. You orchestrate a fleet of agents to do the research, enrichment, sequencing, follow\-up, content drafts, and reporting, so one marketer covers more ground than a traditional team. Agents take on the repeatable work, so the role can stay broad. This role calls for a senior growth marketer with the range to set the message, pick the highest\-leverage bets, and instrument the funnel, then use agents to run it. The work is to look at a messy funnel, find the bottleneck, design the experiment, ship it the same day, and read the data the next morning. You report to the CEO and work across the GTM team. The role is in person. **About You** * You have built a growth marketing function from zero. You have turned messy demand into measurable pipeline at an early\-stage B2B company, ideally dev\-tools, infra, or security, and you can point to the number. * You have real positioning and messaging instincts for a technical buyer. You can hold a conversation with engineers, security leaders, and AI leaders, and turn it into content and campaigns that land. * You have run demand across multiple channels, some mix of SEO, AEO, paid, lifecycle, and content, and you know how to pick the next lever, not just operate the one you know best. * You have run both a self\-serve PLG motion and a sales\-assist motion into a buying committee, and you know they need different plays. * You own the numbers. You are fluent in attribution and funnel analytics, and you can model CAC, payback, and a forecast the team can plan against. If that is not your background, you partner well with whoever owns it. * You are deeply AI\-native and already use agents to multiply yourself. You have built or directed agentic workflows, not just used AI tools, and you are excited to run a fleet of agents as your team instead of hiring one. * You thrive before the playbook exists. You decide what matters, ship within hours, measure what happened, and change direction without a mature org around you. **Nice to have:** * You have stood up outbound that worked, partnering closely with AEs on targeting, messaging, and sequencing, not just running campaigns on your own. * Experience taking a product upmarket, or repositioning and repricing one. * Having built this once already at an AI\-native company. * Field marketing or events experience. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * The room to define how a fast\-growing infrastructure company goes to market, and to build the first AI\-native growth engine from scratch. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product direction. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Austin, TX (WFH)
jobs.description: Full\-Stack Engineer Build. Solve. Own It. At **Vironix**, we're working to make the world a healthier place by changing how healthcare providers monitor and respond to patients. Vironix Health uses advanced AI and remote monitoring to help detect deterioration from viral and chronic illness — giving clinicians better information and patients a better chance to get the right care at the right time. We're a very small team of scientists, technologists, and builders working on a big problem. That means we're not looking for someone who needs a detailed job description telling them exactly where their responsibilities begin and end. We're looking for a **Full\-Stack Engineer who likes to build things.** You'll work directly with our CTO and engineering team to develop and improve the web and mobile applications used by patients and clinicians. You'll write code across the stack, work with APIs and backend services, troubleshoot problems, and take an idea from concept to production. We're much more interested in **how you think and what you've built** than whether your resume lists a particular collection of technologies. What You'll Do * Build and improve web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and other technologies as appropriate. * Work across the stack — including frontend, backend APIs, databases, and application logic. * Write, read, and debug code in Python and other languages. * Work with relational databases, including PostgreSQL. * Take ownership of features and problems from beginning to end rather than waiting for someone else to handle the other half. * Work closely with our CTO and engineering team to turn ideas and requirements into working products. * Help determine **how** something should be built, not just execute someone else's instructions. * Explore and incorporate AI and emerging technologies when they can make the product, development process, or user experience better. * Troubleshoot, experiment, learn, and figure things out when the answer isn't obvious. * Contribute to a product that is being used in real healthcare environments and has real consequences for patients and clinicians. **Requirements** What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is comfortable wearing a lot of hats. You should be someone who: * Has professional coding experience in at least one language and can learn new technologies when necessary. * Has experience developing applications, preferably including mobile applications. * Is comfortable working across the stack rather than staying inside a narrow specialty. * Can work independently without needing every task broken down into detailed instructions. * Enjoys solving problems where there may not be an established process or obvious answer. * Is excited about AI and interested in finding practical ways to use it — not someone who sees it as a threat to the way they've always worked. * Has experience working with small teams where individual contributions matter and ownership is high. * Doesn't need a lot of structure, bureaucracy, or handoffs to get things done. * Is willing to challenge assumptions and ask, **"Is there a better way to do this?"** * Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks. * Has a genuine interest in building technology that can make a difference in healthcare. Experience That Gets Our Attention We're especially interested in people who have: * Recent startup experience * Built and launched applications rather than simply maintaining someone else's code * Worked on small engineering teams with significant individual ownership * Experience with React, React Native, Python, PostgreSQL, or cloud infrastructure * Experience incorporating AI into products or development workflows * A history of learning new technologies quickly to solve a problem **The specific tools you have used matter less to us than your ability to learn, build, and solve problems.** Why Vironix? This isn't a role where you'll spend six months waiting for a committee to approve a change. We're a small team. Your work will have visibility. Your decisions will matter. And what you build can make its way into the hands of clinicians and patients. You'll work directly with our CTO, have a meaningful voice in how products are built, and have the opportunity to help shape both the technology and the way we work. * Competitive salary based on experience * Equity participation in a high\-growth health\-tech company * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Hybrid schedule with intentional in\-person collaboration * Direct impact on technology being used in real clinical care * Small team with high ownership and little bureaucracy * An environment that values **results, initiative, and good ideas over hours logged** Location Our core team is based in **Austin, Texas**. We work primarily remotely with a few intentional days of in\-person collaboration each month.

jobs.title: GPU Kernel Engineer
jobs.description: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next\-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high\-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi\-million\-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands\-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real\-time applications. **About the role** ------------------ We are seeking a highly skilled GPU Kernel Engineer who is passionate about pushing the limits of performance on modern accelerators. In this role, you will design and optimize custom GPU kernels that power next\-generation large\-scale AI systems. You will work across the hardware–software stack, from low\-level kernel development to integrating optimized ops into high\-level ML frameworks used for large\-scale training and inference. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of GPU programming, systems engineering, and cutting\-edge AI workloads, and who wants to make meaningful contributions to the efficiency and scalability of our ML platform. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and optimize custom GPU kernels using C\+\+, PTX, CUDA, ROCm, Triton, and/or JAX Pallas. * Profile and optimize end\-to\-end performance of ML operations, with a focus on large\-scale LLM training and inference. * Integrate low\-level GPU kernels into frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, and custom internal runtimes. * Develop performance models, identify bottlenecks, and deliver kernel\-level improvements that significantly accelerate AI workloads. * Collaborate with ML researchers, distributed systems engineers, and model\-serving teams to optimize compute performance across the stack. * Work closely with hardware vendors (NVIDIA/AMD) and stay current on the latest GPU architecture capabilities and compiler/toolchain improvements. * Contribute to tooling, documentation, benchmarking suites, and testing frameworks to ensure correctness and performance reproducibility. ### **Must\-Haves** * 5\+ years of industry or research experience in GPU kernel development or high\-performance computing. * Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, Python, and familiarity with ML frameworks. * Deep expertise in CUDA/ROCm, GPU memory models, and performance optimization strategies. * Hands\-on experience with Triton and/or JAX Pallas for custom kernel development. * Strong understanding of PTX, GPU ASM, and low\-level GPU execution. * Extensive experience writing and optimizing custom GPU kernels in C\+\+ and PTX. * Proven ability to integrate low\-level kernels into PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks. * Experience working with large\-scale LLM workloads (training or inference). ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * Experience with AMD GPUs and ROCm optimization. * Familiarity with JAX FFI and custom ML operator development. * Experience with efficient model serving frameworks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT). * Experience with TPUs, XLA, or similar accelerator programming environments. * Contributions to open\-source ML systems, compilers, or GPU kernels. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Sciforium is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Compensation Range: $190K \- $250K

jobs.title: Gaming Systems Field Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Shape the Future of Charitable Gaming Technology** ---------------------------------------------------- Arrow International powers entertainment in community venues around the world. Our team builds everything from pull tabs and bingo paper to advanced electronic gaming systems. We reward impact with profit\-sharing, 401(k) matching, comprehensive benefits, and paid time off — including a bonus week every July. ### **A Day in This Role** Morning: you scan your Salesforce queue, triage service tickets, and jump on a remote call to troubleshoot a Windows Server permissions issue. Midday: you arrive at a customer site, install new devices, run cabling, configure software and SQL connections, and verify network/Active Directory settings. Afternoon: you coach staff on system use, document every step, and follow up with distributors about parts and RMAs. Evening: you close out tickets, escalate a tier 3 anomaly to a support specialist, and prep for overnight travel to your next install. ### **What You’ll Tackle** * Diagnose and resolve hardware/software issues with above\-average first\-visit resolution. * Log all service activity in Salesforce with complete and accurate notes. * Provide remote phone support when not traveling; deliver on\-site installs and support as scheduled. * Escalate tier 2/3 cases to the support specialist and notify management promptly when needed. * Coordinate with distributors on parts orders, RMAs, and technical guidance. * Configure and program Arrow equipment; train distributors and end users. * Recommend and implement timely solutions; follow up with customers to ensure satisfaction. * Work effectively from home with reliable high\-speed DSL or cable internet. * Other duties as assigned by management. ### **What You Bring** * Associate degree in Computer Technologies or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of training or equivalent experience with electronic and PC technologies. * Hands\-on knowledge of SQL, Windows, Windows Server, Active Directory, and networking. * Ability to read schematics and technical manuals; strong analytical mindset. * PC, mechanical, and electrical aptitude. * Clear written and verbal communication; excellent customer and phone presence. * Self\-directed with strong time management, planning, and organizational skills. * Proficiency with MS Office and other common software tools; proprietary software experience a plus. * Background in PC application support. ### **Preferred Credentials** * Field support experience. * Support experience with electronic gaming devices; bingo gaming familiarity. * Networking certifications and 2\+ years of related network technology experience. ### **Where and How You’ll Work** * Travel frequently (can exceed 75%); overnight trips are common. * Overtime and standby availability as required. * On\-site work in varied environments: bingo halls, bars, tribal reservations, and casinos. * Physically active installs: run cables, lift heavy equipment, climb ladders. * Flexibility to work any shift and weekends as needed. ### **Our Commitments** #### **Equal Opportunity Statement** Arrow International is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire, train, and promote individuals in all job titles without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, results of genetic testing, veteran status, or physical or mental disability—except where such disability prevents performance of essential job functions and cannot be reasonably accommodated in accordance with applicable laws. #### **Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Statement** Arrow International is committed to complying with the spirit and requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, participate in the interview process, undergo any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise take part in the employee selection process, please contact us at recruiting@arrowinternational.com. To ensure a safe and productive work environment, all candidates who receive a conditional job offer must successfully pass a confidential pre\-employment drug screening, which generally consists of a hair drug test, and receive an acceptable result as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: **About Sapience AI** ===================== Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share. The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that. Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose\-driven for the organization it serves. Let's achieve more, together. **Where this role sits** ======================== This is the senior\-most engineering role at Sapience AI. You own the technology, the architecture, and the engineering organization that build the collective intelligence platform. You are accountable for MINERVA and the COGENT architecture: how they are designed, how they scale, how they stay trustworthy, and how quickly the organization can ship. You set technical direction and build the team that delivers on it. You sit on the executive team, translating company strategy into technical strategy and back, and making the calls that determine whether Sapience AI can build what it has promised. **Why this role exists** ======================== Collective intelligence at the scale of professional communities is a hard systems problem: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning trust, protecting sensitive data, and doing it reliably. Someone has to own whether the technology can actually deliver on the vision. In an AI market moving this fast, the durable advantage is an engineering organization that learns and ships faster than the field, on an architecture that can carry the next several years. The Head of Engineering supplies that. You own the technical strategy, the architecture, the team, and the standards, and you are accountable for turning ambition into a platform that works and holds trust. **What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)** =============================================== You hold eight areas of responsibility across the engineering organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and be accountable for. **1\. Technical strategy and vision** ------------------------------------- * Own the technical strategy that turns company goals into a platform that can deliver them. * Set a clear technical point of view on where AI is heading and how Sapience AI should build for it. * Make the build, buy, and bet decisions that shape the next several years. **2\. Architecture of MINERVA and COGENT** ------------------------------------------ * Own the architecture of the MINERVA platform and the COGENT neuro\-symbolic system, and how they scale. * Ensure the architecture can carry growth, new communities, and rising demands on reasoning and trust. * Balance near\-term delivery against the durable foundations the platform needs. **3\. Engineering organization and talent** ------------------------------------------- * Build, structure, and lead the engineering organization, including hiring, leveling, and leadership development. * Set the bar for engineering craft and hold it. * Create an environment where strong engineers do the best work of their careers. **4\. Delivery and execution** ------------------------------ * Own how the organization plans, ships, and learns, and keep it fast without breaking trust. * Drive delivery through GR and GA milestones with clear accountability. * Remove the blockers that slow the whole organization down. **5\. Trust, security, and reliability** ---------------------------------------- * Own the security, privacy, and reliability of a platform holding sensitive community knowledge. * Make trust a property of the architecture, not a review at the end. * Be accountable for how the platform behaves when it matters most. **6\. AI and research translation** ----------------------------------- * Partner with research and applied AI to turn frontier capability into dependable product behavior. * Decide which advances are ready for production and which are not yet. * Keep the organization honest about what AI can and cannot do. **7\. Executive partnership and company strategy** -------------------------------------------------- * Serve on the executive team, and translate between company strategy and technical reality. * Give the board and leadership a clear, honest view of technical risk and opportunity. * Partner with product on what is possible, and by when. **8\. Cost, scale, and operational excellence** ----------------------------------------------- * Own the economics of running the platform, including inference and infrastructure cost at scale. * Build the operational discipline that keep , including leading and scaling engineering organizations. * Deep technical background in large\-scale systems, and hands\-on credibility that engineers respect. * Direct experience building and operating AI or ML systems in production. * A track record of owning architecture that scaled with a growing business. * Strong judgment on security, privacy, and reliability for sensitive data. * Executive presence, and the ability to translate between business and technical strategy. * A record of attracting, growing, and keeping strong engineers. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with neuro\-symbolic systems, knowledge graphs, retrieval, or agentic AI. * Experience owning inference and infrastructure economics at scale. * Experience in trust\-sensitive or regulated domains. * Familiarity with CRM, AMS, or knowledge\-platform ecosystems. * Experience as a technical co\-founder or early engineering leader. **How you work** ---------------- * You lead with the mission and name the real problem before the solution. * You hold a clear technical point of view and defend it with evidence. * You make hard calls and own the outcomes. * You treat trust, security, and reliability as non\-negotiable. * You build teams where people do their best work and trust each other. * You keep the organization learning and changing course without ego. **Skills \& Competencies** ========================== * Technical strategy and architecture at platform scale. * Building and scaling engineering organizations. * Production AI and ML systems, including reliability and cost. * Security, privacy, and governance for sensitive data. * Delivery leadership and operational excellence. * Executive communication and board\-level partnership. * Translating research and frontier capability into production. **Services \& Tools Experience** ================================ * Modern cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and large\-scale infrastructure. * Distributed systems, data platforms, and ML infrastructure. * LLM, retrieval, vector, and graph systems at an architectural level. * Observability, security, and reliability tooling. * Engineering delivery and planning systems. * Cost and capacity management for AI workloads. * Deep familiarity with the MINERVA platform and COGENT architecture (as the accountable owner). **Prior Experience \& Background** ================================== * Prior senior engineering leadership (VP Engineering, CTO, or equivalent) at a software or AI company. * Experience scaling both an architecture and an organization through growth. * A track record of shipping and operating AI systems in production. * Experience partnering at the executive and board level. **Cross\-functional partners** ============================== You partner most closely with the CEO and executive team, Product, Research, Applied AI, and Security. You lead the engineering organization and are accountable for how MINERVA and COGENT are built, scaled, and trusted. **How we hire** =============== We review every application, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. Research shows that talented people, especially those from underrepresented communities, often hold back when they do not meet every qualification. If that is the only thing holding you back, apply anyway. Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a workplace where everyone, regardless of background, has a voice in building what comes next. **Compensation** ================ Base Salary: $228,000 \- $240,000 \+ early equity Generous health and wellness benefits *Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation to complete our application process, let your recruiter know.*

jobs.title: Lead Network Engineer - EMS Platforms, AAA Services & Network Automation - Dallas, TX or Denver, CO or Scottsdale, AZ
jobs.description: **Lead Planning Engineer Network Planning** **About Forged Fiber** At Forged Fiber, our mission is bold but simple: deliver fast, reliable, future\-proof connectivity that builds the foundation for everything online. As we execute, we believe the right way to do something is the only way. This foundation guides how the company builds, operates, and maintains a state\-of\-the\-art open\-access fiber network platform that empowers millions. Forged Fiber is about more than building a network. It is about people. Every role matters. Every contribution counts. Together, employees create impact through teamwork, trust, and a shared commitment to excellence. **The Role** The Lead Network Engineer is a senior technical leader within the Architecture, Engineering, and Technology Support (AET) organization, responsible for the reliability, lifecycle management, operational support, testing, integration, and automation of network management platforms and core operational systems supporting a Fiber Broadband network. This role serves as the technical authority for EMS platforms supporting Calix, Adtran, and Nokia, AAA services including TACACS\+ and RADIUS, and network automation initiatives. **Network Design and Architecture** * Define architecture standards and operational requirements for EMS, AAA, and network management platforms. * Lead design reviews supporting Calix, Adtran, and Nokia management platforms. * Develop resiliency, redundancy, scalability, and security standards. **EMS Platform Ownership** * Serve as a technical lead for EMS environments supporting Calix, Adtran, and Nokia. * Own software lifecycle management, upgrades, patch validation, and governance. * Define EMS integration requirements with OSS, BSS, inventory, and automation systems. **AAA Services and Network Security Integration** * Design, implement, and support TACACS\+, RADIUS, and centralized authentication solutions. * Develop RBAC and privileged access management standards. * Lead troubleshooting of authentication and authorization issues. **Network Automation and Operational Efficiency** * Develop automation solutions using Python, Ansible, XML, JSON, YAML, and API Integration.. * Create automated workflows for provisioning, compliance validation, testing, and reporting. * Reduce manual processes through automation initiatives. **Core Competencies** * Expert knowledge of EMS, NMS, OSS, and network management platforms. * Advanced knowledge of TACACS\+, RADIUS, and AAA architecture. * Experience supporting fiber broadband and FTTH environments. **Required Experience** * 5\+ years supporting EMS, OSS, NMS, or network management platforms. * Experience with Calix, Adtran, or Nokia EMS platforms. * Experience implementing or supporting TACACS\+ and RADIUS. * Experience developing automation using Python, Ansible, or APIs. **Preferred Experience** * Nokia Altiplano * Calix CMS, SMx or Calix Cloud * Adtran Mosaic * NetBox and OSS/BSS integrations **What We Look** **For** **in a Candidate** Forged Fiber’s culture is built on honesty, respect, trust, transparency, and a growth mindset. We strive to treat people as they want to be treated, and to operate with consistency, integrity, customer obsession, and courage. We’re looking for top tier talent to join Forged Fiber that can help us bring this mindset to our everyday work and deliver meaningful results. **Compensation** This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Field Deployment & Support
jobs.description: **About Destro AI** Destro AI is building the intelligence layer for robotics — the system that coordinates robots, humans, and workflows across complex real\-world operations. Founded by former leaders from HAI Robotics, Dexterity, and Matic, Destro is built on a simple thesis: robotics has solved movement, but not decision\-making. Destro is backed by investors who have previously invested in and built companies like Brex, Figma, Notion, and Instacart. Destro's MothershipOS is a shared brain across all robots, unlocking complex factory and warehouse workflows. Unlike traditional systems that rely on local intelligence on each robot, Destro brings global intelligence across the entire operation. Destro recently closed its Seed round at one of the highest valuations for a robotics company at this stage, and is already deploying in production with large enterprise operators. **About The Role** We're hiring a Robotics Software Engineer, Field Deployment and Support, to own the software that runs MothershipOS in live customer warehouses. This role is responsible for writing and maintaining production code, not solely for troubleshooting it, and will serve as the engineering presence on\-site when systems need to be brought up, stabilized, or restored to full function. **Schedule Expectations** This is a field deployment role, not a standard office\-hours position. Warehouse operations run multiple shifts, and go\-lives, incidents, and integrations are not confined to business hours. * Regular work outside standard business hours should be expected, including nights and weekends. Go\-lives are frequently scheduled during off\-hours or weekend downtime windows to avoid disrupting customer operations. * This role may be paged for production issues, including robot faults, network outages, and server failures, outside normal hours, and is expected to respond promptly, either remotely or on\-site. * Extensive travel to customer sites is required, at times on short notice. * Candidates seeking a fixed 9\-to\-5, Monday\-through\-Friday schedule are unlikely to find this role a fit. **What You'll Do** *Software* * Write, test, and maintain the software services that run MothershipOS at customer sites, including deployment tooling and diagnostic utilities. * Design and build internal tools that make field deployments faster and more repeatable. * Translate field learnings into production\-hardening fixes and improvements in the core codebase. * Maintain clear technical documentation and runbooks so issues can be diagnosed consistently across sites. *Field Deployment* * Deploy and validate Destro's software stack in live warehouses, working directly with customer operations, IT, and engineering teams. * Own production issues end\-to\-end during launch and stabilization, including off\-hours incidents. * Improve uptime, throughput, and reliability of deployed systems through both code and infrastructure changes. *Systems and Infrastructure* * Build and maintain containerized services (Docker Compose) running on Destro\-managed servers and edge devices. * Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP) for image management, versioning, and deployment tooling. * Configure and troubleshoot networking, including VLANs, DHCP, internal DNS, and certificate\-based service security. * Debug across the full stack: robot state faults, sensor issues, API failures, container networking, database queries, and monitoring dashboards. **Who You Are** * 2 to 6 years of experience in systems engineering, robotics software, backend engineering, infrastructure, or field engineering, with genuine software development experience rather than field support alone. * Comfortable being paged off\-hours and traveling on short notice. * Able to operate independently in ambiguous, high\-pressure environments without a fully specified solution. * Calm under pressure, direct with customers, and demonstrates strong ownership. **Technical Skills** *Required* * Strong Python or C\+\+, with the ability to write maintainable, production\-grade code. * Hands\-on Docker/Docker Compose experience, including building, deploying, debugging, and versioning images. * Linux/server administration: command line, logs, processes, systemd, firewalls. * Networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, VLANs, static IP reservations, TLS/certificates. * Experience with APIs and communication protocols (REST, WebSockets, MQTT). * Proficiency with Git and standard software development workflows. *Strongly Preferred* * Experience with AMRs, warehouse automation, or fleet management. * Cloud deployment experience, ideally GCP. * Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or time\-series databases. * WMS/WES/ERP integration experience. *Nice to Have* * Experience with robot task allocation, scheduling, or routing. * Experience with wearables, scanners, or other warehouse hardware.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to put everyday supply and logistics decisions in motion, powered by innovative problem\-solving from industry experts. A lot of companies say it. We mean it: Gravitate is different. Rooted in the spirit of collaboration, we thrive on the smarts of our people and the dynamic we’ve cultivated. **Tell Me About My Job:** If you are considering this role, you are someone who has stopped waiting to be handed well\-defined work. You take a large, ambiguous problem, break it into a plan, and drive it to production — unblocking yourself and the people around you along the way. You’ll own a significant area of Gravitate’s fuel logistics platform — or a full service — and be accountable for its reliability, performance, and evolution over time. That means leading design for complex features, evaluating real trade\-offs between performance, maintainability, and cost, and documenting the decisions so the next engineer understands them. You’ll go deep on the backend: Python services and APIs, data modeling in MongoDB, async and event\-driven processing, running on Kubernetes in GCP and Azure. You’ll also be one of the people we count on when something breaks in production — finding root cause quickly, driving recovery, and then driving the monitoring, observability, and performance improvements that keep it from happening again. Seniority here isn’t just scope of code — it’s scope of influence. You’ll mentor our mid\-level engineers, raise the bar in code and design review, and lead technical initiatives without needing formal authority to do it. We’re strongly against artificial separations of responsibility and throwing work “over the wall.” As a senior engineer here, you’re part of the product team — in the room for the product conversation, not downstream of it. **You’re an Ideal Candidate If:** * **You deliver large things, accurately.** You take a big feature with real unknowns, break it into a plan, estimate it honestly, and land it. When it slips, you raise the risk early instead of hoping. * **You design before you build.** You can hold performance, maintainability, and cost in your head at the same time, pick a direction, and explain why. You design for the change that’s coming, not just the ticket in front of you. * **You own your work in production.** You’re the person who gets to root cause fast on a hard issue, and who cares about the dashboards, alerts, and query plans in your area — not just the feature that shipped. * **You make the engineers around you better.** Your code review comments teach something. Mid\-level engineers seek you out. You lead initiatives because people follow you, not because you were assigned. * **You have strong opinions and hold them honestly.** You argue for the best solution, not necessarily your own, and you can explain a complex technical trade\-off to someone who doesn’t write code. * **You know the business, not just the codebase.** You understand your product area deeply enough to push back on a product decision — and to make a better one. * **You want to work in an AI\-enabled workflow.** You see the impact of AI on code generation and are willing and able to see how it can make you more productive. You want to help in building the harness around it so that the team can get more done. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Drive delivery of large backend features end\-to\-end — breaking large projects into manageable plans, estimating work with moderate unknowns accurately, and raising risks early * Lead technical design for complex features; evaluate trade\-offs across performance, maintainability, and cost; document decisions; design for extensibility * Own a significant area of the product or a full service — accountable for its reliability, performance, and evolution * Build and operate Python services, APIs, and data models (MongoDB) deployed on Kubernetes across GCP and Azure * Debug and resolve medium\-to\-large production issues; quickly identify root cause and drive fast response and recovery * Drive monitoring, observability, and performance health in your product area * Review code and technical designs with constructive, specific feedback; mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, including on how to produce higher\-quality designs * Partner with product on medium\-to\-large features — contributing real feedback and helping shape product decisions in your domain * Write clear technical documents; communicate complex technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive technical discussions * Proactively unblock yourself and others; make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed and quality * Help shape team culture and engineering practices in your area of expertise. **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems * Deep expertise in multiple areas of a backend stack: a primary server\-side language (Python preferred), API design, data modeling, and automated testing * Demonstrated track record of delivering large features end\-to\-end, on plans you built yourself, with moderate unknowns * Experience owning a service or major product area in production — including its reliability and performance, not just its features * Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills on medium\-to\-large issues; comfortable participating in on\-call for what you own * Working knowledge of infrastructure, security, and observability, plus CI/CD and deployment practices * Experience mentoring junior and mid\-level engineers and giving high\-quality code review feedback * Strong written and verbal communication — able to produce clear medium\-to\-large technical documents and explain trade\-offs to non\-technical stakeholders * Openness to utilizing and becoming an expert in AI\-assisted development to supercharge your ability to get stuff done. **Nice to Have Experience:** * Hands\-on experience with our stack: Python, MongoDB, Kubernetes, GCP or Azure * Comfort reaching into React/TypeScript when a feature needs it end\-to\-end * Backend engineering experience in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment * Background in a logistics, supply chain, or energy/fuel domain * Performance and scale work against large data volumes — query optimization, caching, and profiling * AI engineering experience – working with production agentic systems and ML / operations models. **About the Gravitate Team:** To understand who our people are, you should first understand what they’re not: replaceable. Each member of the team is chosen carefully and with intention. We believe that finding the right fit is more important than a laundry list of credentials – and that people are people first, and titles second. Because we hire the Gravitate way, our team is certainly one of a kind. We’ve brought together incredible talent that regularly collaborates to create clean, fresh solutions. That effort has led to remarkable opportunities, including work with many Fortune 500 clients. We’ve found that the winning combination of exciting achievements, trust in one another and open communication lays the groundwork for long\-lasting, successful careers. That, and the fact that we clap for each other at every opportunity. Problem solvers, go\-getters and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **MintMCP** helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. **AI\-Native Startup** We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team, write code, review PRs, and handle sales, marketing, and deal ops on the same gateway we sell to customers. We are building an entire company operating system around them, and you will help build it. **Traction** Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: Sr. Full\-Stack Software Engineer is a remote engineering review track for evaluating production code, debugging traces, and developer\-facing AI outputs against real\-world correctness standards. Reviewers reproduce failures, write the unit test the model should have written, and explain the fix so the modeling team can target the gap. **Why this role matters** ------------------------- Engineering model quality lives or dies on whether the generated code actually compiles, passes tests, and handles edge cases. AuraOne pairs experienced engineers with the modeling team to grade outputs the way a code reviewer would. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Run and reproduce candidate code outputs in a sandboxed environment for Sr. Full\-Stack Software Engineer assignments. * Grade full\-stack engineering solutions for correctness, style, and edge\-case handling. * Write minimal failing tests that demonstrate the bug a model output missed. * Compare paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Tag failure modes (compile error, runtime crash, off\-by\-one, security issue) with severity scores. * Document recurring code\-generation failures so the modeling team can target them. * Calibrate against gold\-standard reviews to keep inter\-rater agreement above target. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Strong day\-job engineering experience — you can read, run, and debug unfamiliar code for Sr. Full\-Stack Software Engineer work. * Comfort writing concise unit tests that capture a single failure mode. * Familiarity with a testing framework. pytest, Jest, or JUnit. Go test, RSpec, or whatever you use. * Clear written reasoning — your review note has to convince another senior engineer. * Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week. * Prior code\-review or technical\-interview\-grading experience is a plus. **Example tasks** ----------------- * Reproduce a generated engineering solution to a coding task, run the test suite, and grade it. * Write the smallest failing test that demonstrates a model's edge\-case bug. * Compare two paired solutions and rank them with a written rationale tied to the rubric. * Triage a security issue surfaced by a model and document the patch the model should have produced. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Open\-source contributions or a public portfolio that demonstrates production\-quality code. * Experience with the target language's standard tooling, linters, and idiomatic style guides. * Familiarity with security\-review checklists (OWASP, CWE) and AppSec patterns. **Skills** ---------- * Code review * Debugging * Unit testing * Software engineering judgment * Full\-stack engineering * Software engineering **Work model** -------------- Remote — US\-eligible.
