jobs.title: Research Engineer Contractor: Motion Planning and Control for Marine Robotics
jobs.description: Job Number: P25T07 Honda Research Institute USA (HRI\-US) is seeking a motion planning and controls researcher/engineer to support research in the marine environment and autonomous vessel domain. The ideal candidate understands trajectory planning, advanced control, reference trajectory/path generation, and system modeling, and can connect these methods to real systems through simulation and field evaluation. You will work on vessel trajectory planning and control and collaborate with Al and Robotics experts, global Honda researchers, and academic partners on research projects and on\-water/field trials. San Jose, CA **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct research in marine robotics with focus on trajectory planning, control, reference paths, and system modeling * Stay current with planning/control approaches including MPC, MPPI, and other optimization\- and sampling\-based methods * Develop and validate vessel dynamics models, including system identification and parameter estimation from simulation and field data * Design planning/control methods that are robust to disturbances and uncertainty (wind/waves/current, model mismatch), including constraint handling and actuator limits * Develop software for early\-stage prototypes and proof\-of\-concept systems (strong experience with ROS2/ROS1, Python, C\+\+) * Run simulation studies and conduct target/field tests; evaluate robustness, stability, and tracking performance under realistic disturbances * Work with localization/state information and integrate planning/control with vehicle interfaces and actuators * Apply and leverage machine learning/AI concepts where relevant (e.g., learned models, prediction, learned cost components) * Assist in documentation: papers, slides, and tech transfer material * Participate in brainstorming activities and cross\-functional collaborations related to autonomous vessel research **Minimum Qualifications** * Master's degree in Robotics Engineering, Naval Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar * Demonstrated experience in motion planning, reference trajectories, and control * Demonstrated experience solving loosely defined research/engineering problems * 2\+ years coding in robotics\-relevant tools/languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C/C\+\+) * Experience creating and using advanced control and motion planning methods * Experience with machine learning algorithms and AI methodologies **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with robotics systems overall; familiarity with perception/tracking interfaces is a plus * Experience with system identification, model calibration, or data\-driven dynamics modeling * Experience with robust/adaptive control or uncertainty\-aware MPC formulations (e.g., disturbance observers, constraint tightening), as applicable * Familiarity with marine robotics and USV/ASV challenges (environmental disturbances, sensing limitations, operational constraints) * Experience programming within Unix\-based operating systems (e.g., Linux) * Programming in Python, ROS1/ROS2, and observer/state\-space modeling concepts **Desired Start Date** 10/05/2026 **Contract Duration** 2 years **Position Keywords** Robotics, Motion Planning, Control, USV, System Identification **Warning:**You do not have the permission to access the upload fields on this form. Contact the form owner or portal administrator to request the access.

jobs.title: Manager, Full Stack Engineering
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= Humana is seeking a Manager, Full Stack Engineering for our Wisconsin Medicaid Market who is equally passionate about leading people and building technology. This is a hands\-on working manager role where you'll spend most of your time designing, coding, reviewing, and delivering solutions alongside a small team of engineers, while also coaching and developing team members. We're looking for a technical leader who leads by example and remains deeply involved in engineering execution. In this role, you'll oversee full\-stack development across two health plan technology environments, including Microsoft\-based applications, Azure cloud services, Dynamics 365, and modern DevOps platforms. You'll drive modernization efforts, improve reliability and security, reduce technical debt, and help prepare systems for future enterprise migration. Success in this role requires a builder's mindset, strong ownership, and a commitment to leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and elevate team performance.**Key Responsibilities** * Lead and develop a team of software engineers through coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development. * Design, build, enhance, and modernize applications, APIs, integrations, and services across multiple technology platforms. * Remain highly engaged in hands\-on software engineering activities, including coding, architecture, debugging, testing, and code reviews. * Establish engineering best practices and maintain high standards for software quality, security, and performance. * Drive modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, technical debt reduction, and platform optimization efforts. * Partner with architects, product owners, business stakeholders, and peer engineering leaders to define technical solutions and delivery priorities. * Implement and promote DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, monitoring, and operational excellence practices. * Champion responsible and effective use of AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality. * Support technology strategies that prepare legacy systems for future migration to enterprise platforms. * Ensure solutions meet security, compliance, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements. **Use your skills to make an impact** ===================================== **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience building and supporting enterprise applications and distributed systems. * Experience leading, mentoring, or managing software engineers in a technical environment. * Hands\-on expertise with Microsoft technologies, including: + .NET / C\# + SQL Server + RESTful APIs and integrations + Modern software design and architecture practices * Experience developing and deploying solutions in Microsoft Azure. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and DevOps practices. * Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy applications and improve operational reliability. * Experience performing code reviews and establishing engineering best practices. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to operate effectively in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional environment. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS). * Experience leading cloud transformation or modernization initiatives. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools and code\-generation technologies. * Familiarity with healthcare, payer, managed care, Medicaid, or regulated industry environments. * Experience implementing DevSecOps and security\-first engineering practices. * Knowledge of HIPAA, PHI handling requirements, and healthcare compliance standards. * Experience supporting complex enterprise integrations and third\-party platforms. * Azure certifications and/or Microsoft technology certifications. Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self\-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information. Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required. **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40**Pay Range** The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $117,600 \- $161,700 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.**Description of Benefits** Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole\-person well\-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short\-term and long\-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.**About us** ============ About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer** It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Become a part of our caring community** ========================================= Humana is looking for a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer to design, implement, and support secure, compliant cloud and DevOps platforms across Azure and GCP. You will ensure enterprise\-scale software delivery through modern CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platforms, GitOps practices, automation, and developer self\-service capabilities. The engineer will provide dedicated ownership of the JFrog platform ecosystem (Artifactory, Xray, and Curation), with a focus on software supply chain security, artifact governance, vulnerability management, and regulatory compliance. As a subject matter expert for JFrog, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runners, this role will drive platform modernization, security remediation, operational excellence, and developer productivity while ensuring reliable, scalable, and secure platform services across the organization. You will also partner with cybersecurity teams to support application security projects, VIT/CVIT remediation, secret management, and emerging software supply chain security capabilities.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain secure cloud infrastructure on Azure and GCP. * Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Harness, and GitOps practices. * Deploy and manage Kubernetes platforms (AKS, GKE, OpenShift). * Own and administer enterprise DevOps platforms including JFrog Artifactory, Xray, Curation, Argo CD, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, GitHub, and GitHub Runner infrastructure. * Implement software supply chain security, artifact governance, dependency governance, vulnerability management, and secure software jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer (Associate)
jobs.description: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long\-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer\-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. We are looking for a Platform Integration Engineer to join our engineering team and take on one of our most strategically important challenges: unifying a diverse ecosystem of analytics applications under a coherent, scalable technology platform. Our analytics landscape has grown organically across multiple teams and products. The result is a collection of powerful but siloed tools — each with its own technology stack, data contracts, and deployment patterns. You will be the connective tissue that brings these applications together, making pragmatic decisions about when to consolidate and when to preserve the right tool for the right job. This role is for an engineer who is energized by ambiguity, skilled at reading distributed systems, and opinionated (but flexible) about platform design. You will work directly with engineering leads and data teams, and you will be empowered to use AI\-assisted development tools as a first\-class part of your workflow.**What** **You’ll** **Do** **Platform Unification \& Integration** * Audit existing analytics applications to understand their underlying technology choices, data flows, and integration points * Design and implement integration patterns (APIs, event streams, shared data contracts) that allow siloed applications to interoperate without unnecessary rewrites * Evaluate build vs. consolidate vs. federate tradeoffs for components across the platform, documenting your rationale and driving alignment * Build and maintain shared platform services — authentication, observability, configuration management, logging — that reduce duplication across applications **Data Pipeline \& ETL Engineering** * Develop a deep understanding of existing data pipelines owned by distributed teams — including their data sources, transformation logic, and dependencies * Design and build a unified presentation layer that surfaces data from heterogeneous compute environments — including large\-scale distributed systems (e.g., Spark) and traditional relational databases — in a consistent, accessible way * Partner with domain teams who have the deepest knowledge of their own data — acting as an integration architect and collaborator rather than a centralized pipeline owner; identify unification opportunities but defer to domain expertise on data semantics and processing logic **Cloud Infrastructure** * Deploy and manage platform services on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP experience a plus) * Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices using tools such as Terraform, CDK, or Pulumi * Collaborate with DevOps/SRE to define deployment pipelines and reliability standards for integration services * Construct evidence\-based business cases for cloud feature adoption — translating technical requirements into business value, risk reduction, and compliance language that resonates with IT governance and procurement stakeholders **What** **We’re** **Looking For** **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 years focused on integration, platform, or infrastructure work * Proficiency in at least one backend language commonly used in data\-intensive systems (Python, Go, Java, or similar); proficiency in two or more languages strongly preferred * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred) including compute, storage, networking, and managed services * Experience building and operating data pipelines (ETL/ELT), including schema management and data quality monitoring * Working experience with AI\-assisted development tooling in a professional engineering context * Strong written communication skills — able to produce clear architecture decision records (ADRs), runbooks, and design documents **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience evaluating and rationalizing heterogeneous technology stacks — i.e., inheriting systems you didn’t design and making them work together * Familiarity with analytics or ML platform tooling (e.g., Airflow, dbt, MLflow, Spark, or SaaS equivalents) * Experience with API gateway management, service mesh, or distributed tracing tooling * Background working with both structured (SQL) and semi\-structured (JSON, Parquet, Avro) data at scale **How You Work** We care as much about how you think as what you’ve built. The ideal candidate for this role: * Is pragmatic over dogmatic — you reach for the right solution given real constraints, not the theoretically perfect one * Communicates tradeoffs clearly to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders * Is comfortable making a recommendation and defending it, but genuinely updates when presented with better information * Brings structure to ambiguous problems — you can walk into a complex legacy system and produce a clear map of what’s there * Understands that “don’t touch what works” and “build it right” are often both correct answers, depending on context * Takes ownership of quality and reliability — you care about what happens after you ship **What We Offer** * Competitive base salary commensurate with experience * Flexible remote\-first or hybrid work environment * Opportunity to define integration and platform patterns that will shape the organization’s technical direction The estimated base salary for this job is $100,000 \- $130,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $112,000 \- $153,400 USD. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future. \#LI\-CL1 \#LI\-Remote **Position Level** ------------------ Associate**Country** ----------- United States of America

jobs.title: Product Development Engineer (Design Specialist - Packaging Hot Runner)
jobs.description: Husky TechnologiesTM is a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky TechnologiesTM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM United States manufacturing facility is located in Milton, Vermont on a large, beautiful campus located just 30 minutes north of downtown Burlington, Vermont. Features include an onsite cafeteria, open office concept, fitness center, intramural sports activities and clean, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment, competitive total compensation and attractive benefits package. Additional things you might like to know about working at Husky TechnologiesTM in Milton, Vermont; * 200,000 square foot bright, clean machine shop * Shift work premiums (25% afternoon shift and 40% evening shift) * Annual incentive bonus * Outstanding 401k contribution and match program * 700 acres of private land to walk, bike, run or cross country ski * On site gym facility * On site cafeteria * Opportunity to work for a world class company with great people Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Range: $125,000\-$155,000 Vacancy: ADD Are you interested in developing new products and technologies? Have experience defining and developing tooling for the packaging market? Do you enjoy working in a dynamic learning environment? Are you interested in joining a team of innovative engineers working for the leading global supplier of injection molding equipment for the plastic industry? If you answered yes, this role is for you. Our Development Engineering team is looking to hire an experienced Product Development Engineer. jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: As a **Systems Engineer**, you will join our Integration Design \& Characterization (IDC) team within the R\&D Assay Integration Group in Westbrook, Maine, helping to develop the next generation of IDEXX diagnostic assays and instrumentation. Willingness to work onsite five days per week in Westbrook, ME is required, with occasional flexibility as needed. The R\&D Assay Integration Group is responsible for integrating assays and instrumentation to deliver reliable, high\-performing diagnostic solutions that enable veterinary professionals to make informed clinical decisions. Why does this role matter? This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of IDEXX's next generation of point\-of\-care diagnostic technologies that advance animal healthcare around the world. As part of a highly collaborative team, you will play a critical role in ensuring diagnostic systems consistently meet performance requirements while supporting innovation across software, hardware, assay, and systems engineering disciplines. This position offers a unique blend of systems thinking, hands\-on engineering, data\-driven problem solving, and cross\-functional collaboration, allowing you to make a direct impact on products that improve outcomes for veterinarians, patients, and customers. **In this role:** ----------------- * You will define, evaluate, and specify instrument sequence functions and algorithms, assessing their impact on assay performance through protocol development, experimentation, and data analysis. * You will develop and utilize custom fixtures, tools, and software solutions to control, characterize, and evaluate diagnostic systems. * You will identify potential failure modes and design robust assay sequences and algorithms that account for operational variability and system tolerances. * You will qualify assay sequences and algorithms against product requirements and performance expectations. * You will follow established engineering design, development, documentation, verification, and validation practices throughout the product lifecycle. * You will support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering capabilities and technical excellence across the organization. * You will analyze field performance data, troubleshoot system issues, investigate root causes, and develop effective corrective actions. * You will specify, test, and implement software modifications to improve system functionality and performance. * You will collaborate closely with scientists, software engineers, hardware engineers, manufacturing partners, and business stakeholders to successfully integrate assays into new and existing diagnostic platforms. * You will manage and interpret characterization data to inform design decisions and support product development milestones. **What you need to succeed:** ----------------------------- * You have a Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, along with 3 to 5 years of professional experience. (Required) * You can translate assay and reagent requirements into instrument sequence definitions and algorithm specifications. (Required) * You can independently plan, prioritize, and manage your work while communicating status, risks, and commitments. (Required) * You have experience analyzing test data, identifying probable failure modes, and developing and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies. (Required) * You can design, build, and utilize fixtures that support system characterization and testing activities. (Required) * You have experience working effectively within cross\-functional product development teams. (Required) * You possess strong verbal and written communication skills and can explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences. (Required) * You thrive in fast\-paced environments and can adapt to changing business priorities, stakeholder needs, and technical requirements. (Required) * You are proficient with Microsoft 365 applications. (Required) * You have working knowledge of computer\-aided design (CAD) tools such as SolidWorks. (Required) * You have an understanding of immunoassay or clinical chemistry principles and how reagent chemistry interacts with instrument mechanics, optics, and fluidics. (Strongly Preferred) * You have experience programming in Python. (Strongly Preferred) * You are familiar with source\-level software debugging techniques and related development tools. (Strongly Preferred) * You have experience using analytical tools such as JMP. (Strongly Preferred) * You have exposure to AI\-assisted tools. (Preferred) * You have experience with LabVIEW, real\-time software environments, or embedded systems development. (Preferred) * You have a foundational understanding of life sciences and biological systems. (Preferred) **What you can expect from us** ------------------------------- * Base salary range starting at $80,000 based on experience * Opportunity for annual cash bonus * Health / Dental / Vision Benefits Day\-One * 5% matching 401k * Additional benefits including but not limited to financial support, pet insurance, mental health resources, volunteer paid days off, employee stock program, foundation donation matching, and much more **Why IDEXX** ------------- We're proud of the work we do, because our work matters. An innovation leader in every industry we serve, our team members help pet owners worldwide keep their companion animals healthy and happy, ensure safe drinking water for billions, and help farmers protect livestock and poultry from disease. Within IDEXX Veterinary Software, we are transforming how veterinary teams manage workflows, connect with clients, and deliver care. Our solutions help practices operate more efficiently while strengthening engagement with pet owners and improving patient outcomes. We have customers in over 175 countries and a global workforce of more than 10,000 team members. Our culture embraces challenges, encourages learning and discovery, and supports employees with competitive compensation, benefits, and meaningful work that drives improvement. If meaningful work and a sense of purpose are at the top of your list, you'll find it here. **Let's pursue what matters together.** *IDEXX values a diverse workforce and workplace and strongly encourages women, people of color, LGBTQ\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *IDEXX is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Head of AI & Program Technology Engineering
jobs.description: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people worldwide for a better future. **Background:** Build the AI systems that will reach hundreds of millions of people in the world's hardest places. Nearly 240 million people will need humanitarian aid in 2026, and global funding has fallen by more than half. Closing that gap demands a different kind of humanitarian organization — one that uses AI to multiply what frontline workers can do, reaches people before crises hit, and brings diagnostic and decision\-support tools to places the technology industry has historically ignored. The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is already one of the most ambitious AI\-deploying humanitarian organizations in the world. We are working on dozens of AI initiatives across 30\+ countries: agentic systems serving millions of displaced people through Signpost; anticipatory action models that deliver aid in advance of a disaster; pocket\-sized AI diagnostics and AI teaching mentors. We have strategic partnerships with AI partners and a portfolio of programs ready to scale. We are hiring a Head of AI Engineering to lead the technical team that builds these systems — and to help shape what we build next. J**ob Overview:** This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who wants to build at the frontier of applied AI in service of humanitarian impact. You will lead a team of engineers and AI specialists designing and shipping AI\-powered, program\-facing solutions — primarily agentic systems, predictive analytics, and AI diagnostics deployed in low\-resource and high\-stakes settings. **You will own three things:** **Technical strategy and direction for IRC's program\-facing AI portfolio.** You will help translate IRC's AI ambitions into a clear technical roadmap, make build\-vs\-buy\-vs\-partner decisions, and set the architectural direction for systems that need to work reliably in some of the hardest operating environments on earth — including AI that runs offline on low\-cost smartphones, agentic systems with high safety standards, and diagnostic models trained on populations the major datasets ignore. **A high\-performing engineering team.** You will manage and grow a team of engineers, applied AI engineers, and QA specialists; raise the bar on engineering quality; and build the kind of culture that attracts top technical talent to mission\-driven work. **Deep partnership with program leaders and strategic partners.** You will be a true thought partner to IRC's program experts in health, education, protection, resettlement, and emergency response — co\-designing solutions with them rather than receiving requirements. You will also help us get maximum value from our flagship partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, and other frontier labs, with direct access to frontier models, early features, and the researchers building them. **Major Responsibilities** **AI Strategic Leadership** * Translate IRC's AI strategy and program priorities into a prioritized technical roadmap, in close partnership with program leaders, the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture, and the T4P demand pipeline. * Stay at the edge of AI/ML advances — particularly in agentic systems, multimodal models, and edge/on\-device inference — and bring promising approaches to IRC's programs. * Serve as a core member of IRC's AI leadership, helping shape organizational direction alongside the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture and other senior leaders. * Champion responsible, human\-centered AI deployment in some of the most sensitive humanitarian contexts in the world, with t  partnership with the SVP for Research, Innovation, AI, and People \& Culture * **Position directly supervises:** Engineers, applied AI engineers, ML specialists, and QA staff on the T4P Development team. * **Other internal contacts:** Program leaders across CRRD, RAI, R\&I, and Signpost; the Enterprise Applications and DevOps teams; the AI governance and policy team; AI@Scale (I@S) leadership; IT leadership across regions and HQ. * **External contacts:** Strategic partners with leading AI organizations; technology vendors; AI sector peers; NGO tech community; major foundation funders. **Job Requirements** *Strong candidates will bring most — not necessarily all — of the following:* **AI and engineering depth** * Hands\-on experience building and shipping production AI systems — agentic frameworks, LLM applications, RAG systems, computer vision, or applied ML pipelines. * Solid full\-stack foundation (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks) with the technical credibility to engage directly with engineers on architecture and design decisions. * Experience with cloud architecture (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP transferable), including AI services, DevOps pipelines, and cost\-effective scaling. * Working knowledge of data security and privacy practices for sensitive or personally identifiable information. **Leadership and collaboration** * 7–10\+ years in software engineering or technical product development, with 3\+ years leading engineers as a manager or tech lead. * A track record of building or growing strong engineering teams — hiring, raising the bar, and creating a culture people want to be part of. * Ability to engage non\-technical leaders as a peer: explaining trade\-offs clearly, listening well, and translating between worlds. * Comfort operating across global teams, time zones, and contexts very different from your own. **Mindset** * Genuinely motivated by humanitarian impact * Leads with humility. Deep respect for the people closest to the problem, including those without technical backgrounds. * Technically curious and forward\-looking — reads, experiments, and brings new ideas to the team. **Nice to have** * Experience deploying AI in low\-resource, low\-bandwidth, or offline contexts. * Prior work with humanitarian, development, or global health organizations. * French or Arabic language skills. **Working Environment** Standard office work environment; hybrid/remote available. Some travel may be required for partner meetings, field engagement, and sector conferences. **Compensation**: (US Pay Rate: 185,000\-200,000 USD); (UK Pay Rate: 87,000\-100,000 GBP) Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements. **Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings **Equal Opportunity Employer:** IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Principal Mechanical Design Engineer **Organization** : Data Center Infrastructure Team **Location** : Remote\* OR Austin, TX * Requires up to 30% domestic and/or international travel (rare) **What liquid cooling applications within hyperscale data centers, including primary and in\-rack cooling solutions. * Have expertise in both enclosed and facility\-based cooling systems * Have experience (in/outlet), Flow Uniformity and Durability) * Proficiency with testing concepts for leaks/mitigation and hydrostatic pressure validation, flow resistance analysis, and corrosion assessments to comply manufacturing, design and function (Machining and Welding, Surface Finishing, Material and Surface Treatments, Post\-Production Cleaning, Flow Optimization, Thermal Expansion, Connection Interfaces, High\-Point Vents and Low\-Point Drains) * Review CAD/Technical Data Packages to determine and validate mechanical design requirements for components and their functions within a system environment * Responsible for understanding product specifications, plumbing, and hydronic systems to lead reviews with all disciplines ensuring the design and components meet performance and applicable code requirements * Ability to evaluate thermal data collected from engineering or manufacturing tests to confirm product conformance to thermo\-mechanical requirements, testing and modeling * Knowledgeable in fabrication practices and installation of copper, stainless steel and aluminum piping for large\-scale cooling systems * Understanding and conducting stress and flow analysis to ensure that the piping systems can withstand operational conditions without failure * Collaborate with project managers on design quotations * Provide technical input to identify and mitigate project risks that may impact project plans and schedules * Conduct component selection for pipes, fittings, and valves based on factors like fluid type, temperature, pressure, and corrosion resistance in chillers, HVAC systems and liquid cooling loops * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to design and ensure system compatibility and integration for liquid cooling systems at the rack, site, equipment, and system levels, including water chillers, heat exchangers, Air Handler Units, and more * Ability to prepare technical specifications for piping components and systems, including testing procedures, installation procedures and maintenance guidelines * Utilize CAD tools, CAE tools, and equipment for engineering tasks * Evaluate/optimize manufacturing assembly processes by designing, components, sub\-assemblies, and system integration * Capable of creating a Bill of Materials (BOM) for release to manufacturing * Perform tests, debug, and validation of mechanical systems and support manufacturing processes * Manage relationships with mechanical component vendors and contract manufacturers * Keep updated with the latest technologies and methods to ensure competitive and cost\-effective des echnical procedures, and government regulations * Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides * Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries * Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices * Comfortable working as part of a global team * Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones * Familiar with stage\-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLCM) * Able to mentor junior engineers * Ability to travel 20% to 30% as required **Preferred * Payment integrations * Product catalogs * Customer checkout systems **Software \& Technology** * Custom software * Web applications * Business automation * CRM systems * Internal dashboards * API integrations * Database solutions * AI integrations * Customer\-management systems **Digital Business Solutions** * SEO services * UI/UX improvements * Website performance improvements * Business process automation * Digital transformation services * Online customer acquisition systems **Additional JLT Opportunities** * Engineering projects * Logistics opportunities * Manufacturing opportunities * Product\-development services * Technical consulting * Commercial business projects Preferred Technical Knowledge Experience with any of the following is beneficial: * HTML * CSS * Artificial intelligence integrations You do not have to personally develop every project you sell. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is: * Entrepreneurial * Self\-motivated * Sales\-driven * Technically knowledgeable * Comfortable prospecting * Persistent * Professional * Organized * Goal\-oriented * Comfortable working independently * Interested in building long\-term customer relationships Schedule Flexible schedule. jobs.title: Applied AI & Systems Associate
jobs.description: Applied AI \& Systems Associate About the Role K12 Computers is looking for an **Applied AI \& Systems Associate** to help us build the next generation of our internal business systems using AI. This is **not a traditional software developer position**. We're looking for someone who understands how businesses operate, enjoys solving problems, and is excited about using tools like **OpenAI Codex and other AI development tools** to turn ideas into working applications, automations, and workflows. You'll work directly under our Value Chain Engineer – Applied AI to identify operational problems across the company and rapidly build solutions for them. Instead of spending most of your time writing software from scratch, you'll use AI\-assisted development to move quickly from: **Business Problem → Process → AI\-Assisted Build → Test → Deployment → Improvement** What You'll Work On You'll help build and improve systems supporting areas such as: * IT asset receiving and inventory * Device auditing and grading * Quality assurance * Warehouse operations * E\-commerce operations * Logistics * Customer portals * Reporting and analytics * Sales and business development * Financial workflows * Data integrations * Internal automations * AI agents and AI\-assisted workflows Our systems interact with databases, APIs, business applications, and real\-world operational processes. What You'll Actually Do You'll spend your time working with employees throughout K12 Computers to understand how their jobs work and where technology can make them better. You'll: * Identify repetitive or inefficient business processes. * Translate operational problems into clear system requirements. * Use **Codex and AI\-assisted development tools** to build applications and features. * Create internal tools, dashboards, forms, workflows, and automations. * Work with databases and structured business data. * Connect systems through APIs and integrations. * Test AI\-generated code and troubleshoot problems. * Prototype new ideas quickly instead of waiting months for traditional software development. * Document how systems and workflows operate. * Train employees on new tools. * Collect feedback from users and continuously improve what you've built. * Work with our Applied AI leadership on larger automation and AI initiatives. Who We're Looking For We're more interested in **how you think and what you can build** than a specific degree or number of years of experience. You may be a good fit if you: * Are naturally curious about how businesses operate. * Regularly use AI tools to solve problems. * Have experimented with Codex or other AI coding tools. * Can take a vague business problem and turn it into a working solution. * Understand basic programming concepts even if you aren't a professional developer. * Are comfortable learning new software quickly. * Enjoy automating repetitive work. * Can communicate with both technical and nontechnical employees. * Are willing to test, fail, troubleshoot, and try again. * Want to work in an environment where you can build things that employees actually use. Experience with any of the following is helpful but **not required**: SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, APIs, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, GitHub, workflow automation, ERP systems, databases, dashboards, or AI development tools. What This Role Is NOT This isn't a position where you'll spend six months engineering one application. It's also not an IT help desk role. Our goal is to use modern AI development tools to allow a small team to build business software at a speed that previously required a much larger development organization. We're looking for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of: **Business Operations \+ AI \+ Software \+ Automation** The Person We're Trying to Find You might be finishing college, have a few years of professional experience, or have taught yourself through building projects. What matters most is that when someone says: "We're doing this manually every day. There has to be a better way." Your instinct is to figure out how to build one. Compensation **$45,000–$65,000 annually**, depending on experience and demonstrated ability. This position provides an opportunity to develop practical experience in applied AI, business systems, automation, databases, APIs, and AI\-assisted software development while working directly on systems used in real business operations. Pay: $45,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Kapsch is one of Austria's most successful global technology companies. With its comprehensive ITS (Intelligent Transportation Systems) portfolio, Kapsch is actively addressing the challenges of the present and the future with intelligent mobility solutions in a wide range of application areas. As a family\-owned company founded in 1892 and headquartered in Vienna, Kapsch can look back on 130 years of experience with the future. To learn more about our solutions and innovations, visit our website here. As Lead Systems Engineer, you'll hold the highest level of technical ownership on our Systems Engineering track, joining a dispersed, cross\-disciplinary team of hardware, software, and electrical engineers. You'll own how the pieces come together as one working system — roadside hardware, embedded devices, applications, and back\-office software — from bid phase through integration, commissioning, and operational handoff on high\-visibility tolling and roadside infrastructure programs that continue to expand as the toll road increases in capacity, capabilities and integrates new technologies. This is a role for someone who wants to be the technical face of the client relationship, build trust with customers over the life of a program, and own the requirements baseline from the first conversation through final acceptance. You'll translate customer needs into clear, buildable, and verifiable requirements; manage expectations and scope as the solution evolves; and lead difficult technical conversations. You'll also hold the seams between hardware and software where most programs get into trouble, maintain the end\-to\-end technical view of the solution, and step in to drive the technical path forward whenever the team hits a roadblock. **How You'll Make an Impact** * **Serve as the primary technical point of contact** —Lead technical discussions, understand the client's business and operational objectives, communicate tradeoffs clearly, manage expectations, and navigate difficult technical or scope conversations with professionalism and sound judgment. * **Own the requirements baseline end\-to\-end** — lead requirements elicitation, analysis, decomposition, specification, validation, traceability, and change control from the first customer conversation through final acceptance. Translate customer needs and contractual requirements into clear, testable, and achievable system requirements, while identifying gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and risks before they become program issues. * **Manage requirements and scope as the solution evolves** — establish and maintain requirements traceability across hardware, software, electrical, integration, and verification activities. * **Own the integrated solution end\-to\-end** — from bid\-phase sales support, proposal review, and requirement gap analysis, through hardware and software design decisions, to integration, commissioning, and operational handoff. * **Overall responsibility for the technical implementation** \- including installation/implementation phase ensuring the system is delivered efficiently to required quality. * **Define and control the interfaces** between roadside hardware (sensors, cameras, controllers, gantry equipment, power) and the software layer (applications, databases, back\-office systems) — specifying protocols, data flows, timing, dependencies, and failure behavior so subsystems perform as one system. * **Support integration, verification, and validation** — support the test and commissioning strategy, drive FAT/SAT, and lead troubleshooting where hardware, firmware, and software meet in the field. * **Design and maintain the full solution architecture** — systems, interfaces, protocols, databases, and applications — while maintaining end\-to\-end awareness of where bottlenecks exist, where requirements are at risk, and where the design can be optimized. * **Lead cross\-functional teams across the program** — align hardware, software, and electrical engineering against a single requirements baseline, resolve technical dependencies, and keep both internal stakeholders and the client informed as the design evolves. * **Build out the physical design layer** — wiring diagrams, civil drawing interpretation, and cable/conduit layouts — partnering with highway designers to fit our technology into the physical infrastructure. * **Set the technical direction and standard for how the team delivers** — step in to unblock the team and propose solutions when work stalls, challenge assumptions constructively, and provide the technical leadership needed to keep the program moving. * **Connect technical execution to customer outcomes** — understand not only what the system must do, but why the client needs it to work that way. Use that understanding to make practical engineering decisions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver solutions that satisfy both technical requirements and operational objectives. **What Makes You a Great Fit** * Bachelor's Degree in E rs, understanding their needs, managing expectations, communicating technical tradeoffs, and handling difficult scope or technical discussions directly with the customer. * 5\+ years implementing technical solutions, with a practical background in systems engineering, including system architectures, interfaces, protocols, databases, and frameworks. * Demonstrated ownership of hardware/software integration through at least one full lifecycle — design, integration, test, commissioning, and handoff. * 4\+ years of experience and expertise across two or more of: electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, software, embedded/firmware, database, or systems integration engineering. * Strong requirements engineering experience — eliciting requirements from customers and stakeholders, writing and decomposing requirements, identifying gaps and ambiguities, establishing traceability from customer specifications through verification, and managing requirements and change control on a live program. * Excellent communication and relationship\-management skills, with the ability to establish credibility with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and maintain productive client relationships through challenging project situations. * Working knowledge of IP networking — enough to integrate, configure, and troubleshoot devices on the network (our environment runs on Cisco). Certification not required. * Proven ability to lead technical conversations with customers, make sound technical decisions, and guide successful cross\-functional collaboration. * Ability to develop and deliver technical presentations while engaging with and managing client relationships. * Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear requirements, specifications, interface definitions, technical documentation, and customer\-facing communications. * Ability to recognize when a customer request represents a requirement clarification, a change in scope, or a technical risk — and appropriately manage each situation. * Curiosity, ownership, and a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mindset, balanced with strong team collaboration. **Bonus Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification. * Networking certification (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent). * Background in tolling or traffic systems. * Prior technical or people leadership. * Project management skills, with knowledge of business economics. * Experience estimating time and effort for system functionalities. * Familiarity with relevant international standards. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to solve complex problems that improve the daily lives of people around the world. * Career growth, stability, and the opportunity to develop within a global organization. * A full benefits package, including unlimited paid time off, 11 paid holidays, 401(k), a no\-cost medical insurance option for employees and eligible dependents, and an FSA option. **Take the next step in your career with Kapsch** *We believe hiring is a human decision. AI supports some of the operational side of our process (things like interview scheduling and coordination), but every step that matters is handled by a person. Your application will be read, your interviews will be conducted, and your offer will be made by humans who are genuinely invested in getting it right.* *Applicants must have working rights in the US and pass a background check.* *Kapsch is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact our TA team. Kapsch TrafficCom is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. Kapsch TrafficCom is a drug\-free workplace.*

You'll also hold the seams between hardware and software where most programs get into trouble, maintain the end\-to\-end technical view of the solution, and step in to drive the technical path forward whenever the team hits a roadblock. **How You'll Make an Impact** * **Serve as the primary technical point of contact** —Lead technical discussions, understand the client's business and operational objectives, communicate tradeoffs clearly, manage expectations, and navigate difficult technical or scope conversations with professionalism and sound judgment. * **Own the requirements baseline end\-to\-end** — lead requirements elicitation, analysis, decomposition, specification, validation, traceability, and change control from the first customer conversation through final acceptance. Translate customer needs and contractual requirements into clear, testable, and achievable system requirements, while identifying gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and risks before they become program issues. * **Manage requirements and scope as the solution evolves** — establish and maintain requirements traceability across hardware, software, electrical, integration, and verification activities. * **Own the integrated solution end\-to\-end** — from bid\-phase sales support, proposal review, and requirement gap analysis, through hardware and software design decisions, to integration, commissioning, and operational handoff. * **Overall responsibility for the technical implementation** \- including installation/implementation phase ensuring the system is delivered efficiently to required quality. * **Define and control the interfaces** between roadside hardware (sensors, cameras, controllers, gantry equipment, power) and the software layer (applications, databases, back\-office systems) — specifying protocols, data flows, timing, dependencies, and failure behavior so subsystems perform as one system. * **Support integration, verification, and validation** — support the test and commissioning strategy, drive FAT/SAT, and lead troubleshooting where hardware, firmware, and software meet in the field. * **Design and maintain the full solution architecture** — systems, interfaces, protocols, databases, and applications — while maintaining end\-to\-end awareness of where bottlenecks exist, where requirements are at risk, and where the design can be optimized. * **Lead cross\-functional teams across the program** — align hardware, software, and electrical engineering against a single requirements baseline, resolve technical dependencies, and keep both internal stakeholders and the client informed as the design evolves. * **Build out the physical design layer** — wiring diagrams, civil drawing interpretation, and cable/conduit layouts — partnering with highway designers to fit our technology into the physical infrastructure. * **Set the technical direction and standard for how the team delivers** — step in to unblock the team and propose solutions when work stalls, challenge assumptions constructively, and provide the technical leadership needed to keep the program moving. * **Connect technical execution to customer outcomes** — understand not only what the system must do, but why the client needs it to work that way. Certification not required. * Proven ability to lead technical conversations with customers, make sound technical decisions, and guide successful cross\-functional collaboration. * Ability to develop and deliver technical presentations while engaging with and managing client relationships. * Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear requirements, specifications, interface definitions, technical documentation, and customer\-facing communications. * Ability to recognize when a customer request represents a requirement clarification, a change in scope, or a technical risk — and appropriately manage each situation. * Curiosity, ownership, and a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves mindset, balanced with strong team collaboration. **Bonus Qualifications** * Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification. * Networking certification (CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent). * Background in tolling or traffic systems. * Prior technical or people leadership. * Project management skills, with knowledge of business economics. * Experience estimating time and effort for system functionalities. * Familiarity with relevant international standards. **What We Offer** ----------------- * The opportunity to solve complex problems that improve the daily lives of people around the world. * Career growth, stability, and the opportunity to develop within a global organization. * A full benefits package, including unlimited paid time off, 11 paid holidays, 401(k), a no\-cost medical insurance option for employees and eligible dependents, and an FSA option. **Take the next step in your career with Kapsch** *We believe hiring is a human decision. AI supports some of the operational side of our process (things like interview scheduling and coordination), but every step that matters is handled by a person. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer Oracle, Spark & Cloud Analytics
jobs.description: **Summary:** We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in Oracle\-based analytical platforms and Apache Spark to support large\-scale data modernization, migration, and analytics initiatives. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience building high\-performance data pipelines, optimizing large\-scale data processing workloads, and integrating enterprise data platforms with modern cloud analytics solutions. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and optimize large\-scale data processing solutions using Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Python. * Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for analytical and reporting workloads. * Optimize query performance, Spark jobs, and end\-to\-end data processing pipelines for high\-volume batch and near real\-time workloads. * Design and implement data integration, replication, and ingestion solutions using technologies such as Oracle GoldenGate, Kafka, and CDC frameworks. * Collaborate with application, data, and analytics teams to develop scalable data models and processing frameworks. * Drive performance tuning initiatives across Oracle, Spark, and distributed data processing environments. **Required Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles. * Strong hands\-on experience with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) and Python. * Deep understanding of Oracle databases supporting OLAP, data warehousing, and analytical workloads. * Proven experience tuning and optimizing: * Spark applications and execution plans * Complex SQL queries * Large\-scale ETL/ELT processes * Candidates must be able to work onsite at the Lenexa office three days per week. * **Eligibility:** Candidates must be authorized to work and reside in the United States. No Corp\-to\-Corp (C2C) or Contract\-to\-Hire (C2H). At this time, Keyhole Software is unable to provide visa sponsorship. **About the Role** ------------------ Keyhole Software is seeking an experienced Full Stack Java Developer to join our consulting team. Our consultants are full\-time members of Keyhole Software, working across a variety of long\-term client engagements throughout their careers. We’re looking for a well\-rounded developer with strong Java experience and the ability to contribute across both backend and frontend development. Depending on the client engagement, you’ll work with technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, relational databases, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks like React or Angular. This is a **hybrid position based out of Lenexa, Kansas, with three days per week onsite required**. As a Keyhole consultant, you’ll be expected to do more than write code. You’ll collaborate with client teams, understand business and technical requirements, contribute to architecture and design decisions, troubleshoot complex issues, and adapt to different technologies and environments as projects evolve. A genuine enthusiasm for using AI throughout the software development lifecycle is important to this position. Our most successful consultants are incorporating AI\-assisted development into their daily workflows to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, troubleshoot problems, strengthen testing, and develop better software. security, authentication, and authorization using technologies such as OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect. * Experience modernizing legacy Java applications or migrating applications to newer frameworks and architectures. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native application development. * Experience working in enterprise environments with complex integrations Package (for full\-time Keyhole employees):** * Medical insurance (traditional \& HDHP options) * Dental and vision insurance * FSA \& dependent care options * Life and disability insurance * 401(k)
