jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** **Division:** **Nucor Steel Brandenburg** **Location:** **Brandenburg, KY, United States** **Other Available Locations:** **N/A** **Deadline:** **September 21, 2026** Located on the banks of the Ohio River, Nucor Steel Brandenburg is a state\-of\-the\-art plate mill, part of North America’s largest steel and steel products manufacturer, and the continent’s largest recycler. Since beginning operations in 2022, our Brandenburg mill has been producing world\-class plate steel using innovative and sustainable technology. At Brandenburg, we combine Nucor’s nationwide strength and stability with the close\-knit culture of a growing team. Safety is our highest priority, and our culture of teamwork and accountability empowers every teammate to contribute, innovate, and succeed. We take pride in not only building steel, but also building strong communities and lasting careers. Nucor Steel Brandenburg teammates enjoy industry\-leading pay, a performance\-driven bonus structure, and a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance * 401(k) and Roth retirement plans with profit sharing * Nucor stock investment program * Tuition reimbursement and scholarship opportunities * Paid parental leave * And more Come build your career with us at Brandenburg — where opportunity, innovation, and community come together. **Basic Job Functions:** ------------------------ The role of the Automation Engineer (Software Engineer) is primarily two\-fold. First, to be a great Nucor team member who demonstrates high levels of honesty, integrity, and ownership in everything they do. Second, is to ensure the success of the team by SAFELY performing maintenance, programming, and upgrade tasks on Level II software systems, as well as proposing and implementing innovative solutions to challenges in the steel making process and business. Multiple automation positions will be hired and successful candidates will be assigned to a mill area based on experience and need. Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Fundamental control theory knowledge * 2\+ years’ experience in industrial controls role or similar * Must be willing to work weekends, holidays, and scheduled and unscheduled overtime *Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US, Nucor Steel Brandenburg will not sponsor the need for a visa now or in the future.* **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Industrial process automation communications experience (i.e. Ethernet IP, Profinet, Profibus, etc.) * Knowledge of languages and/or technologies including C\#, .NET, SQL, JSON, XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, machine learning * Can contribute and function at multiple levels of the Purdue Reference Model for enterprise control * Can design or build advanced optimization, simulation, and automation systems within a manufacturing environment ***Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug\-free workplace***

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real\-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be. Joining our team means embracing a fast\-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you. Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Brief Summary of Role** We’re looking for an experienced, hands\-on Product Manager who loves figuring out how things work and can’t wait to make them better. You’ll join our growing team as an individual contributor, turning messy, technically complex problems into solutions and products that people actually use \- and checking that they made a difference! You don’t need prior insurance experience; curiosity, ownership, and strong product judgement matter most. You’ll own a meaningful product area end\-to\-end: bring your own point of view, get clear on why it matters to customers and the business, and build it with Design and Engineering. You enjoy turning “could we…?” into a working first version. You’ll think across customers, agents, internal teams, and interconnected systems. Initial ownership is open, with room to contribute access domains as priorities evolve. You’re the person who asks, “What does the data say?” and then goes looking, talking to customers and teammates along the way. You can explain tradeoffs, make timely decisions with incomplete information, and follow through on results after launch. You’re curious beyond the current tools and playbook. If you find a smarter way to do something, you’re eager to try it with the team and share what worked (and what didn’t). **What you'll Do** * **You’ll be a product owner:** Take a problem from “we should…” to shipped, used, and improved. The backlog is a part of the job, not the finish line. Shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area, define KPIs and success upfront, and use business and customer evidence to prioritize. You can point to work you’ve owned through multiple iterations and explain what changed as you learned. * **You’re the best listener in the room:** Seek out customer insight, relevant data, and cross\-functional input without treating every request as a requirement. Weigh options, make tradeoffs visible, and explain both what you recommend and what you choose not to do. You know which decisions need a deeper dive and which need a sensible call so the team can keep building. * **You get that product building is a team sport:** Build trust across Engineering, Design, Technical Project Management, QA, operations, and business partners. Bring people into decisions early, navigate disagreement, and create clarity that helps others execute with confidence. You’re happy to own the hard call, share the credit, and jump in when a fellow PM needs a hand. Making the team better is part of the fun. * **You’re mission first:** You get stuff done. Help the team turn business priorities into clear work that’s ready to build, without getting stuck in planning limbo. Balance larger bets with smaller, high\-leverage improvements, remove avoidable process drag, and keep attention on outcomes. You’ve improved the flow, clarity, or quality or work reaching engineering and can show how you evaluated results after launch. * **You can get your hands dirty:** Turn complex problems into clear, buildable work with Design and Engineering. Bring experience with technically deep products, such as APIs, integrations, data pipelines, or Salesforce’y systems. You’ll happily dig into an API spec or sketch a workflow in Figma to understand what’s going on under the hood. Learn enough to ask good questions, spot constraints, and sequence the work \- and notice when the UX still feels clunky. * **You can work async:** You don’t need someone hovering over your shoulder to move things forward. Own decisions as context shifts, and leave a trail your teammates can actually follow: research, decisions, metrics, and open questions that are easy to find and use. You can show who a written artifact or stakeholder conversation clarified a complex decision, resolved disagreement, or enabled others to act. * **Nice to have:** Experience in insurance, insurtech, fintech, or another regulated environment; Salesforce, data products, carrier/partner integrations, or workflow\-heavy B2B software; or balancing platform work with customer facing improvements. Have you built a scrappy AI prototype, tinkered with an agent, or found a better way to show an engineer what you mean? We’d love to hear about it! These are help additions,  ’ll have partners and support, but you’ll be expected to seek relevant input, explain tradeoffs, and make timely calls as context evolves. * You only get excited about shiny new features. Some of the most satisfying wins here will be fixing a stubborn workflow or making an integration behave. You should enjoy improving the machinery as much as the experience it powers. * * You prefer to disappear until the big reveal. We like seeing the rough draft, asking questions, and making it better together. Bring ambition and a strong POV \- and be ready to change your mind. There’s plenty to own without competing for credit. **Interview Process** At Obie, transparency is core to our interview process. We focus on open communication and a positive experience; no trick questions—just honest conversations about your skills and aspirations. To help you prepare, please familiarize yourself with these resources before moving forward: * Our company’s blog to learn more about the market we serve and the information our customers value. * Check out our LinkedIn to see how people interact with our brand and product. * Press and podcast features like Inc. 5000, TechCrunch, Innovate State, Uncontested Investing Podcast, Insurtech Amplified Podcast * Meet us and get to know Obie You'll first talk to Kara on a 30\-minute call to determine whether we’re a good fit for one another. You’ll learn more about Obie and have the chance to ask about our company, team, culture, and product. * Meet the hiring manager Next, you'll have a 45 minute video interview with the hiring manager, Adam Tsouras, to assess your technical skills. * Complete a Project Exercise This role requires strong planning, collaboration, and communication skills, so we'll also present you with a short exercise to complete to provide you a chance to flex those muscles. You will be able to complete this exercise on your own time, so please be thorough and use the resources available to you. We'll be looking to see your problem solving abilities, writing and communication skills, empathy, general demeanor, and ability to leverage key product management strategies. More on this when you get there! * Meet the Team Since you'll be joining a close\-knit team, we'll ask you to meet other people in the company so we get to know each other a bit better **Moving Forward with Obie** Obie is leading the future of real estate investment protection, securing over $25 billion in coverage for thousands of policyholders nationwide. Backed by $39 million in funding and recognized as a top workplace by Built In and Inc., we’re committed to driving progress for our customers and team. Through advanced digital tools, a trusted agent network, and strategic partnerships, Obie provides real estate investors the insurance coverage they need to move forward confidently. **Obie has you Covered** Being in the insurance industry, we understand the importance of comprehensive benefits for you and your family. These are just some of the benefits and perks we provide: * Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance * Flexible paid time off * Retirement savings plan with company match Obie values transparency and data driven decision making, enabling us to have a consistent and equitable approach to compensation. We are informed by a benchmarking tool which provides real time compensation data allowing us to regularly check our salary ranges against other venture backed companies and startups within our industry. We've provided the full base salary range for this role below, but please note that we typically target the mid point of the salary range to allow room for growth within the role. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of relevant experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 130,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Electrical Technician
jobs.description: **About Odys** -------------- At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in\-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking. We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high\-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from **20 kW** to **4 MW**, with applications in the air or on the ground. One of those applications is **Laila**, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW\-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold\-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter\-UAS measures. The market interest has been overwhelming: **Over 30** inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and **14\+ DoD** **contracts**. Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high\-volume production, and electrified mobility. We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high\-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most. **Creating the future** of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. **Electrical Technician** **Responsibilities** * Build, route, and terminate low\- and high\-voltage (14 V DC to 800 V DC) wiring harnesses, connectors, and cable assemblies for propulsion, avionics, and flight\-control systems. * Fabricate and populate PCBs, breakout boxes, and test fixtures; perform rework and component replacement to IPC\-610/620 standards. * Install, calibrate, and maintain sensors (current, voltage, temperature, pressure, vibration) and data\-acquisition hardware on propulsion test stands and prototype aircraft. * Execute continuity, insulation\-resistance, and hipot tests; diagnose faults with oscilloscopes, multimeters, CAN bus analyzers, and high\-voltage safety equipment. * Collaborate with power\-electronics, motor\-control, and avionics engineers to integrate inverters, converters, and PMSM motor drives into propulsion testbeds. * Document build procedures, wiring diagrams, and inspection results. * Support environmental, vibration, and EMI/EMC test campaigns; assist with rapid troubleshooting during ground and flight testing. * Champion a culture of safety by enforcing lock\-out/tag\-out, HV PPE, and hazardous\-energy control procedures in the lab and hangar. **Requirements** * Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Avionics, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3\+ years of experience assembling and troubleshooting aerospace, automotive, or industrial electrical systems at voltages above 300 V DC. * Proficiency in reading electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and harness drawings (KiCad, Altium, or similar). * Demonstrated skill in crimping, soldering, harness over\-braiding, heat\-shrink moulded parts, and connector back\-shell termination. * Familiarity with IPC/WHMA\-A\-620, NASA\-STD\-8739, or comparable workmanship standards. * Working knowledge of CAN, RS\-422/485, and Ethernet wiring practices, shielding, and grounding. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to execute tasks independently while meeting tight deadlines. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with eVTOL or aerospace powertrain development, including DO\-160G environmental and EMI/EMC test procedures. * Hands\-on exposure to inverters, gate\-driver circuits, and high\-frequency switching layouts. * Certification to IPC\-J\-STD\-001 (Space Addendum) or FAA Repairman Certificate for wire harness assembly. * Familiarity with HV safety interlocks (HVIL), battery management systems, and contactor control logic. * Experience installing and troubleshooting flight\-worthy instrumentation (strain gauges, thermocouples, RTDs) and associated DAQ software. * Proven track record supporting prototype aircraft or UAV flight\-test programs in cross\-functional engineering teams. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to generate clear build logs, discrepancy reports, and red\-lined drawings for configuration control.

jobs.title: SUPPLY CHAIN ENGINEER
jobs.description: **Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility?** Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. **Supply Chain Engineer \- Battery** ==================================== **Location:** Troy,MI **Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Long\-Term, At\-Will **Target Start Date:** October 2026 **Position Summary** -------------------- The Supply Chain Engineer plays a critical role in supporting new program launches and driving supply chain excellence across manufacturing operations. This position is responsible for advanced supply chain planning, logistics and packaging optimization, cost estimation, process standardization, and systems support. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Purchasing, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Plants, Operational Excellence, and Information Systems teams to develop efficient, cost\-effective, and scalable supply chain solutions that support business growth and operational performance. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead advanced supply chain planning activities for new product launches in partnership with Program Purchasing, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, and Operational Excellence teams. * Develop logistics and packaging cost estimates and provide RFQ support throughout the program development lifecycle, from sourcing through SOP. * Serve as the subject matter expert for supply chain planning tools, including: + Plan for Every Part (PFEP) + Supply Chain Estimator + Component Packaging Form (CPF) * Establish and monitor logistics and packaging investment targets for development programs, ensuring alignment with project objectives and financial expectations. * Maintain and continuously improve regional and global supply chain procedures, standards, and work instructions. * Partner with Information Systems (ISS) as the key user representative to prioritize system enhancements and ensure business requirements are effectively translated into technology solutions. * Own and maintain the "Day in the Life" process matrix, driving standardization of plant supply chain routines and best practices. * Develop and deliver training programs on supply chain processes, systems, and tools for both plant and development teams. * Ensure compliance with SAP, INGOAL, and other supply chain systems while identifying opportunities to streamline processes and eliminate waste. * Provide support to manufacturing plants regarding supply chain systems, process execution, and operational challenges. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance inventory management, material flow, logistics performance, and overall supply chain efficiency. * Support plant KPI achievement by providing coaching, training, and hands\-on assistance related to supply chain performance metrics. * Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to optimize transportation, warehousing, packaging, and material flow strategies. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Required** * Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business, Purchasing, or a related field. * Minimum 5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain planning, transportation, or materials management. * Experience managing external logistics flows and supply chain operations within a manufacturing environment. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and reporting. * Experience working with third\-party logistics providers (3PLs). * Knowledge of ERP systems, preferably SAP. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Fluent in English. * Legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship requirements. ### **Preferred** * Automotive manufacturing experience. * Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing principles, including: + Pull Systems + Kanban + Heijunka * Experience supporting new program launches and APQP environments. * Import/export compliance and customs knowledge. * Understanding of CTPAT certification requirements. * Experience with packaging development and optimization. * Proficiency in a second language is a plus. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Unlimited access to online learning and development platforms * Career growth opportunities within a global mobility technology leader * Dynamic, collaborative, and innovative work environment **At OPmobility, people truly matter.** We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly \- because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. **Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work.** You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting\-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real\-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. **With €11\.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R\&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact.** All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition. Oldcastle Infrastructure \- Built For Life from Oldcastle Infrastructure on Vimeo. **Job Summary** The Production Engineer will report directly to the Plant Manager and will support the operational and technical needs of our Trench Plants, which manufacture Plastibeton Trench Products. The successful candidate improves industrial processes to increase efficiency, reduce cost, enhance sustainability, and maximize profitability. **Job Location** * This role is based in our plant in Acworth, GA. **Job Responsibilities** * Safety \& Compliance + Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving, and adhering to safety policies in all work environments and areas. * Trench Plant \& Plastibeton Product Support + Support manufacturing processes specific to Plastibeton Trench Products, including batching, forming, curing, trimming, and finishing operations. + Analyze and enhance trench production flow, material handling, and equipment performance to increase throughput and product consistency. + Develop and implement automation and controls improvements related to trench manufacturing work cells and equipment. * Process Improvement \& Lean Activities + Assess plant operations and recommend improvements, including cost/benefit analysis and ROI justification. + Lead kaizen events and structured problem solving initiatives focused on efficiency, quality, and waste reduction. + Perform tests on plant systems to determine equipment efficiency and process capability. + Prepare reports on operating efficiency, failure investigations, and improvement outcomes. * Automation, Controls \& Technical Support + Develop and enhance process control automation and computer applications for process control (including PLC/HMI troubleshooting and optimization). + Work closely with plant staff, process area teams, and equipment suppliers to ensure reliable operation and successful implementation of improvements. * CAPEX \& Project Management + Lead and manage CAPEX projects, including automation upgrades, controls related projects, equipment improvements, and layout modifications. + Provide project management support across functional teams to deliver initiatives on schedule and within budget. Collaborate With Us** Depending on your interests and availability, collaboration may include: * Consulting and technical advisory * Participation in **pre\-sales activities** (solution design, estimations, technical discussions with clients) * Conducting **technical interviews and expert evaluations** * Supporting project delivery and implementation * Architecture reviews and technical audits * Mentoring and supporting internal engineering teams ##### **Forms of Cooperation** The Expert Network offers several cooperation models: * **Part\-time collaboration** Flexible, on\-demand involvement for consulting, interviews, or pre\-sales * **Full\-time cooperation** Long\-term, project\-based engagement when mutual interest aligns * **Advisory partnership** Occasional expert involvement for knowledge sharing, workshops, and reviews All cooperation is managed under **B2B contracts**, with **remote work** as the default format. ##### **Who This Is For** This role is a great fit if you: * Have a stable full\-time role but want to stay actively involved in the industry * Are interested in flexible collaboration and additional professional opportunities * Enjoy working with different domains, clients, and technologies * Want priority access to future full\-time or long\-term opportunities at OLSYS ##### **Benefits of Joining the Network** * Flexible workload and collaboration formats * Exposure to diverse projects, domains, and technologies * Direct involvement in pre\-sales and client\-facing discussions * Priority consideration for future full\-time opportunities at OLSYS * Access to a professional expert community * Long\-term collaboration with like\-minded professionals ##### **What Joining the Network Means** Joining the OLSYS Expert Network There is **no immediate obligation** – instead, we build a trusted connection and stay in touch. When relevant opportunities appear, you will be among the **first experts we reach out to**. Yuliia Syvukha Lead Recruiter

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Manufacturing Engineer II is responsible for independently developing, optimizing, and implementing manufacturing processes. This position serves as a technical resource to production and works cross\-functionally with engineering, quality, maintenance, supply chain, and operations to improve manufacturing performance. The Manufacturing Engineer II leads process\-improvement initiatives, resolves complex manufacturing problems, develops tooling and fixtures, supports new product introduction, and provides technical direction for manufacturing processes. The position is expected to identify opportunities proactively and take ownership of projects from concept through implementation. ***Essential Functions:*** * Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes * Provide technical leadership and engineering support to production operations. * Lead improvement projects focused on safety, quality, throughput, labor efficiency, capacity, and cost reduction. * Design and implement fixtures, jigs, tooling, gauges, and other production aids. * Create and maintain routings, work instructions, standard work, process documentation, and labor standards. * Lead root\-cause investigations for recurring quality, productivity, and manufacturing issues. * Implement corrective and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness. * Conduct time studies, capacity analysis, line balancing, and process\-flow analysis. * Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives. * Identify and eliminate waste, bottlenecks, excessive handling, setup time, downtime, rework, and other sources of manufacturing inefficiency. * Support new product introduction from prototype through production launch. * Evaluate product designs for manufacturability and recommend design improvements. * Evaluate engineering changes and determine appropriate manufacturing methods and implementation requirements. * Support capital equipment projects, including equipment selection, justification, installation, commissioning, and process validation. * Analyze manufacturing data and establish measurable process\-performance improvements. * Work with vendors and suppliers on tooling, equipment, materials, and process\-development activities. * Ensure manufacturing processes comply with safety, quality, and applicable regulatory requirements. * Participate in production planning and capacity discussions as needed. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering field. * 3–7 years of manufacturing engineering experience, preferably in metal fabrication or a similar discrete manufacturing environment. * Strong understanding of metal fabrication processes and manufacturing methods. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, specifications, and bills of material. * Experience with CAD software such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or similar. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and project\-management skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. * Ability to communicate effectively with production, engineering, quality, maintenance, and management personnel. * Demonstrated ability to independently lead manufacturing improvement projects. **Preferred:** * Experience designing fixtures, tooling, and gauges. * Experience with ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing software. * Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification/training. * Experience with automation, robotics, or machine integration. * Experience developing labor standards and manufacturing cost estimates. * Experience with process capability, SPC, FMEA, and structured problem\-solving methods. **Key Competencies** * Advanced manufacturing and process knowledge * Technical problem solving * Project leadership * Process optimization * Design for manufacturability * Data analysis * Continuous improvement * Cross\-functional communication * Decision making * Mentoring and leadership * Strong ownership and accountability **Success Measures:** Success in this position is demonstrated by the ability to: * Independently identify and resolve complex manufacturing problems. * Lead projects that measurably improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, or cost. * Develop robust, repeatable manufacturing processes. * Successfully launch new products and manufacturing processes. * Reduce scrap, rework, labor content, setup time, and production downtime. * Improve manufacturing capacity and overall equipment utilization. * Establish effective standards, documentation, and process controls. * Serve as a trusted technical resource for production and engineering teams. * Mentor less\-experienced manufacturing engineers and technicians. * Consistently deliver projects with measurable business results. ***Physical Requirements:*** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: GIS Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About OneEnergy Renewables** OneEnergy’s mission is to make clean energy the \#1 source of electricity for consumers and utilities. We develop solar energy and battery energy storage (BESS) projects across the United States in community solar, distributed generation, and large utility scale project segments. Our diverse project pipeline, multiple locations across the US, and unique multidisciplined team sets us apart. We are a dynamic and innovative renewable energy industry company committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving positive change in our industry. **About the role** The GIS Data Engineer will bring technical expertise to lead the advancement of OneEnergy's data systems. This role owns the architecture, pipelines, and automation that turns spatial and tabular data into reliable, well\-modeled resources. The role works closely with the Commercial Strategy and GIS teams to support functions across the company including Development, Real Estate, Systems, Engineering, and Finance. Successful candidates will have a demonstrated track record of building data pipelines and architecture, ownership of strategy and systems, and strong communication and project management. **What you'll do** * Design and maintain PostgreSQL/PostGIS databases and schemas. * Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, clean, transform, and load geospatial and tabular data from internal systems, ArcGIS, APIs, and external datasets. * Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and professional development support to GIS team members. * Write and optimize SQL and Python code to automate geoprocessing, data validation, and recurring data workflows. * Design data models and table structures that scale. * Build and maintain integrations (APIs, views, exports) that make spatial and tabular data available to dashboards, applications, and analytics tools used across the company. * Document data architecture, pipeline logic, table schemas, and data lineage. * Collaborate with the Commercial Strategy, Development, Systems, Engineering, and Finance teams to translate data needs into scalable, well\-engineered solutions. * Evaluate and lead decision\-making for new tools, technologies, and architectural approaches as data needs grow in volume and complexity. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, GIS, or a related field, or comparable level of professional experience. * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, database architecture, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of taking technical ownership of a project or system. * Strong experience in Python and SQL, with hands\-on experience building data pipelines, automation scripts, and geoprocessing workflows. * Experience designing and managing a relational SQL database (PostgreSQL or similar); experience with PostGIS, ArcSDE, or similar preferred. * Demonstrated mentorship and interpersonal skills, with the ability to coach, mentor, and support the professional growth of GIS team members. * Experience designing and building data architecture and ETL/ELT pipelines. * Experience with JavaScript mapping applications such as ArcGIS Maps SDK, Mapbox GL JS, Leaflet, OpenLayers, or similar preferred. * Experience with server and system architecture is a plus. * Experience with Esri’s ArcGIS ecosystem (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcPy). * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. * Strong attention to detail with a high level of integrity and organizational capacity to manage multiple projects. * Experience with project management and leading projects with a small team. * Self\-motivated with proven ability to take ownership, initiative, and accountability. * A willingness to contribute to our culture which thrives on building trust and holding one another accountable. **Compensation:** Seattle, WA: $124,000 \-$155,000 (additional compensation up to $174,000 may be available to candidates with demonstrated experience in people leadership). OneEnergy’s compensation packages are dependent on an array of factors including, but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, geographic location, and other organizational needs. We provide generous Paid Time Off (six weeks/year) and an impactful Volunteer Time Off Program. We offer robust employee benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, 401(k) matching retirement plan, life insurance, wellness incentives, and more. We recognize an equitable energy transition requires the participation of diverse communities, groups, and institutions. OneEnergy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or handicap, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Clinical Product & Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered
jobs.description: Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered **Company:** M Systems **Location:** McKinney, Texas / Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time, depending on candidate experience and availability **Industry:** Healthcare Information Technology / Electronic Health Records (EHR) About M Systems M Systems develops healthcare information technology solutions for small and medium\-sized hospitals, including rural hospitals, emergency hospitals, and other healthcare organizations. Our platform supports a broad range of hospital functions, including clinical documentation, patient care workflows, behavioral health, operating room workflows, billing, accounting, and other healthcare management capabilities. We are seeking a nursing professional who can serve as the **clinical voice of the product** and work closely with our software engineering, product, implementation, compliance, management, and customer teams. Position Summary M Systems is seeking a **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager** to provide clinical domain expertise for our healthcare software products. **Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; qualified nursing students will also be considered.** We welcome candidates who are actively pursuing an ADN, BSN, or equivalent nursing qualification and who have strong clinical knowledge, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in healthcare technology. The successful candidate will help ensure that M Systems' EHR and clinical applications accurately support real\-world hospital workflows and meet applicable healthcare regulatory, compliance, usability, and product\-quality expectations. The individual will serve as a bridge between: * Nurses and physicians * Hospital administrators * Customers * Product management * Software developers * Quality assurance teams * Implementation teams * Compliance and certification organizations This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse or nursing student interested in combining **clinical knowledge, healthcare technology, software product management, compliance, and clinical informatics**. Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Product Management Serve as an internal clinical subject\-matter resource for M Systems' EHR and healthcare applications. Review product functionality from the perspective of nurses, physicians, and other hospital users. Help engineering and product teams understand real\-world clinical workflows and identify gaps between software functionality and actual clinical practice. Provide clinical input for new product features and product improvements. Participate in product planning and prioritization discussions. Translate clinical needs into clear software requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate whether proposed product functionality is clinically practical, safe, and easy for hospital staff to use. Clinical Workflow Expertise Provide domain expertise for workflows such as: * Patient registration * Admission * Transfer * Discharge * Nursing assessment * Vital signs * Clinical documentation * Nursing notes * Physician notes * Medication workflows * Medication administration * Physician orders * Nursing orders * Allergies * Problem lists * Patient history * Care plans * Laboratory results * Diagnostic results * Clinical alerts * Behavioral health workflows * Operating room workflows * Emergency department workflows * Clinical handoffs * Patient discharge instructions * Follow\-up care * Patient\-safety workflows Work with customers and internal teams to understand variations in workflow between different hospitals and care environments. Product Testing \& Clinical Validation Develop and execute realistic clinical test scenarios for M Systems applications. Test software using patient\-care scenarios similar to those encountered in hospitals. Perform: * Functional testing * Clinical workflow testing * User acceptance testing * Regression testing * End\-to\-end workflow testing * Usability testing * Patient\-safety\-related testing * Release validation Create detailed clinical test cases and expected results. Document software defects, workflow issues, usability problems, and clinical concerns. Work directly with software engineers to reproduce problems. Verify fixes after engineering changes are completed. Participate in software release reviews and confirm that major clinical workflows have been appropriately tested before release. Develop regression test suites for critical clinical functions. Clinical Quality Assurance Help establish a structured clinical quality assurance process for M Systems products. Create repeatable testing procedures for clinical modules. Maintain traceability between: * Clinical requirements * Product requirements * Regulatory requirements * Software functionality * Test cases * Test results * Defects * Corrective actions Identify high\-risk clinical workflows that require additional testing. Help establish release\-readiness criteria for clinical functionality are testing * Defect tracking * JIRA or similar tools * Clinical workflow documentation * HL7 * FHIR * USCDI * Healthcare interoperability * Healthcare terminology * Clinical coding concepts * Healthcare privacy and security Key Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: * Clinically knowledgeable * Detail\-oriented * Analytical * Organized * Patient\-safety focused * Comfortable using technology * Curious about how healthcare software works * Able to identify workflow problems * Comfortable communicating with software developers * Comfortable working with nurses and physicians * Able to communicate with hospital administrators * Willing to research healthcare regulations * Able to maintain detailed compliance documentation * Interested in healthcare technology and clinical informatics * Comfortable working in a growing organization The candidate should also be comfortable questioning workflows that do not make clinical sense and clearly explaining why a workflow should be changed. Initial Priorities During the initial phase of the role, the Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager will focus on: * Learning the complete M Systems clinical product suite. * Documenting major clinical workflows. * Creating standardized clinical test scenarios. * Performing end\-to\-end testing of key EHR workflows. * Identifying functional and clinical usability gaps. * Establishing a structured clinical QA process. * Building a compliance and certification requirements matrix. * Identifying certification\-readiness gaps. * Creating clinical product documentation. * Supporting customer workflow discussions and demonstrations. Key Performance Objectives Success in this role will include: * Establishing a structured clinical product testing process * Developing comprehensive clinical test scenarios * Improving product usability for clinicians * Identifying workflow issues before customers encounter them * Reducing clinical defects found after software releases * Maintaining clear product and clinical documentation * Establishing a compliance and certification roadmap * Improving traceability between requirements and testing * Providing clear clinical requirements to engineering * Improving communication between clinicians and engineering * Supporting successful hospital implementations * Improving clinical product demonstrations * Supporting certification\-readiness activities Career Growth This role can provide significant career growth for a nursing professional interested in healthcare technology. Possible career progression may include: **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager → Senior Clinical Product Manager → Director of Clinical Informatics / Clinical Product \& Compliance → Clinical Informatics Leadership** The position provides hands\-on exposure to healthcare software design, engineering, compliance, interoperability, customer implementation, and product strategy. Why Join M Systems? This is an opportunity for an RN or nursing student interested in building a career at the intersection of **healthcare and technology**. Instead of only using an EHR system, you will have an opportunity to help **design, test, validate, improve, and shape the EHR itself**. You will work directly with software engineers, healthcare professionals, customers, and company leadership. Your clinical knowledge will influence how M Systems products are designed and how nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals interact with the system. For a nursing student interested in healthcare technology, clinical informatics, product management, or healthcare IT, this role can provide practical experience that is difficult to obtain through a traditional nursing position alone. For an experienced RN, the position provides an opportunity to move into healthcare technology while continuing to apply clinical expertise in a meaningful way. Pay: Up to $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off * Parental leave * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: In person

decisions and feedback. * Design how AI features appear in the product and how users understand and interact with them. * Partner with product management and engineering on problem definition, scope, enterprise software interfaces for workflow\-heavy products. * A portfolio showing component libraries, data display, and navigation and interaction patterns you designed and maintained. * Experience jobs.title: Senior RF Hardware Engineer
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Avionics team is responsible for the full lifecycle of Terran R's nervous system, designing, building, testing, installing, and operating the hardware that connects and controls every major electrical system on the vehicle and ground. The team leverages close partnership between avionics design, manufacturing, and test to enable rapid iteration and feedback loops. Engineers are deeply embedded into other functions within Relativity, working closely with propulsion, GNC, fluids, and stage engineering teams to ensure seamless integration and operation. Now is a unique time to join: you'll get to help shape Terran R's fundamental avionics architecture and be given a high degree of ownership on components that will fly. **About the Role:** In this role you will be responsible for owning the development, test and integration of GPS\-based navigation system avionics used within the Terran R launch vehicle. You will work with cross\-functional partner teams across the company, conducting architectural trades, developing acceptance and qualification test plans, while being responsible for critical sensory infrastructure allowing for the landing, recovery, and reuse of the vehicle booster stage. Furthermore, you'll help to provide technical guidance across the vehicle's RF architecture \- including telemetry downlinks, command uplinks, and antenna system deployment. You'll mentor hardware engineers on RF design fundamentals, review design analyses, and support architectural trades. This cross\-system collaboration ensuring that our RF systems work cohesively from design through operations. **About You:** * + Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * 5\+ years of experience in electronics designed for harsh environments and mission\-critical applications such as launch vehicles, spacecraft, aircraft, or robotics * Experience with hardware bring\-up, validation, debugging, and data analysis * Experience working with highly cross\-functional teams (GNC, mechanical, electrical, software, etc.) to develop integrated electronics solutions * Deep understanding of RF system fundamentals including: + Impedance matching and transmission line theory + Link budget analysis and RF propagation effects + Antenna theory (gain, beamwidth, polarization, radiation patterns) **Nice to haves:** * In\-depth knowledge of GNSS receiver systems including PVT calculation, satellite tracking/acquisition, error sources, and RF front\-end architecture * Understanding of RF communication systems including modulation schemes (FSK, PSK, OQPSK, SOQPSK), channel coding, and bit error rate analysis * Experience in combining data from various navigation sensors (GPS, IMU, magnetometers, altimeters, LiDAR, etc.) to achieve robust and accurate navigation solutions * Experience with high\-speed serial interfaces (SPI, PCIe, Ethernet, etc.); memory interfaces; design for SoCs, microcontrollers, and microprocessors **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Compute & Storage, Autonomy
jobs.description: Rivian's Autonomy org needs a Staff Software Engineer, Compute \& Storage to own the distributed compute and storage platform that every autonomy workload runs on. This sits in the Platform Services team in the AI Platform organization in the Autonomy team. Autonomy training, simulation base evaluation / validation, and autonomy visualization all depend on the same two things: available compute and fast access to data. The role requires deep expertise in Kubernetes\-based distributed compute, large\-scale object storage, and the performance and cost tradeoffs of running both at petabyte scale. You'll work with the AI Platform, Perception, Planning, Simulation, and Vehicle Integration, Product Management, and other technology partners to operate a platform serving a fleet of over 100,000 vehicles, hundreds of petabytes of drive and simulation data, and training clusters of thousands of GPUs across multiple clouds. This is a platform ownership role, and it's measured by what it lets other engineers do: how fast someone goes from idea to trained model or data pipeline, how many scenarios simulation runs per day, and what each of those costs. * Own the architecture and roadmap for Autonomy's distributed compute platform: job scheduling, quota and fair\-share across teams, autoscaling, and spot and preemption strategy across multiple clouds. * Build scalable tools and APIs that turn high\-level job requests into executed work, making large\-scale computation accessible to engineers who aren't infrastructure specialists. * Read the jobs other teams run, profile them, and find inefficiencies and bottlenecks. Fix them directly, or give the team the tooling to see them. * Treat cluster efficiency as a primary metric: eliminate GPU fragmentation, right\-size quota, and reclaim capacity stranded on partially filled nodes. * Own the storage architecture for autonomy data at petabyte scale, including layout, partitioning, tiering across hot, warm and cold, lifecycle policy, and the caching and prefetch layers that keep training and simulation jobs from starving on I/O. * Own the multi\-cloud compute and data path as training extends beyond a single provider, including replication strategy, consistency, and cross\-provider egress economics. * Drive throughput and turnaround time for the heaviest workloads: training data loading, large\-scale log replay, and batch resimulation running tens of thousands of concurrent jobs. * Own the queue\-based and event\-driven infrastructure behind job submission and autoscaling, and keep it stable as queue depth moves by orders of magnitude. * Own platform observability: define the metrics and build the dashboards and alerting that make job throughput, queue health, cluster utilization, and per\-team cost visible to you and the teams you serve. * Define SLAs for job admission, completion, and data availability. Set the on\-call strategy and take part in the rotation. * Own compute and storage cost as a first\-class engineering metric, instrumented per team and per workload, across multiple AWS accounts and services. * Work with the security \& privacy team on data governance, access control, retention, and audit for vehicle\-collected data. * Set technical standards for how distributed workloads are built and run, and raise the bar through design review, code review, and mentorship of senior engineers. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production. * 5\+ years owning a distributed compute, batch execution, or scheduling platform used by other engineering teams: building the scheduler, orchestration layer, or execution engine itself, not just jobs that ran on one. * 5\+ years with Kubernetes as an execution substrate: scheduling, resource management, custom controllers or operators, autoscaling, and failure modes at scale. * 5\+ years with large\-scale object storage: data layout, partitioning, lifecycle and tiering, caching, and the performance and cost tradeoffs among them. * 3\+ years with a distributed processing or training framework (Ray, Spark, Flink, or Dask). * 3\+ years hands\-on with Go, C\+\+ or Rust, plus strong Python. * 3\+ years with infrastructure as code and configuration management (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation), and container build and supply chain. * 3\+ years with queueing and event\-driven systems (SQS, Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent), including autoscaling workloads on queue depth. * 3\+ years with production monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or CloudWatch): defining the metrics and building the dashboards, not just consuming them. * 3\+ years debugging production distributed systems, including resource contention, stragglers, data skew, network saturation, and cascading failure, and running root\-cause analysis on incidents. * 2\+ years carrying an infrastructure cost target and meeting it. * Ability to turn ambiguous, high\-level requirements into a detailed system design and drive it to completion unprompted. * Technical influence beyond your own commits: designs others build on, standards others adopt, engineers who improved from working with you. * Nice to have: GPU cluster management and utilization, including topology\-aware placement, gang scheduling, multi\-tenant sharing, and fragmentation. * Nice to have: autonomous vehicle, robotics, or another domain with continuous high\-volume sensor data. * Nice to have: multi\-cloud or hybrid cloud and on\-premise operation, including data movement economics between providers. * Nice to have: Linux internals, including the CPU scheduler, memory management, file systems, and networking.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, ML Data Infrastructure, Autonomy
jobs.description: Rivian's Autonomy org needs a Staff Software Engineer, ML Data Infrastructure to own how autonomy data is described, indexed and accessed. This sits in the Platform Services team in the AI Platform organization in the Autonomy team. Our fleet of 100,000\+ vehicles produces a continuous stream of multi\-modal drive data, plus the output of every model run against it and every simulation executed on it. The role requires deep expertise in columnar and analytical data stores, schema and format design, and the query and access layers that ML and analytics teams depend on. You'll work with the AI Platform, Perception, Planning, Simulation, and Vehicle Integration, Product Management, and other technology partners. Autonomy data currently lives across multiple systems because no single store serves all our access patterns: fleet\-scale byte storage, petabyte\-scale analytics, sub\-second fleet\-wide search, and small transactional state each have different cost and latency profiles. You'll own the unified metadata and query layer, decide what consolidates and what stays specialized, and land the migrations onto a unified data lake. * Own the unified data layer for autonomy: a single interface over document metadata, high\-cardinality columnar analytics, real\-time search, and object\-stored sensor payloads, so engineers query concepts rather than databases. * Design the architecture for the datalake, metadata access and the APIs that expose it, giving engineers a single access layer * Own the data access and format strategy, including the canonical log format used in production today and the choice of ML\-native columnar and vector access going forward. Define the canonical schemas, own their evolution, and drive the migration path. * Design and build batch and streaming pipelines for eval data, and the storage layer behind them, to handle both the volume and diversity of metrics from on\-road and simulation runs at their actual cardinality. * Build the indexing and discovery layer for fast semantic and metadata search across the fleet's data: scenario tagging, event indexing, embedding\-based similarity search, and the query surface engineers use. * Improve the data mining tools that apply ML techniques to data discovery, so Perception, Behavior and Planning engineers can find rare and long\-tail scenarios at fleet scale rather than searching by hand. * Build well\-documented tools and APIs so engineers outside data infrastructure can find, slice and materialize the data they need without writing a pipeline. * Treat data correctness as a discipline: schema validation, contracts between producers and consumers, freshness and completeness monitoring, and alerting that catches bad data before a model trains on it. * Build continuous testing and monitoring for the platform, covering ingest health, data freshness, schema conformance and query performance. * Design to the workflows of Perception, Behavior, Planning and Simulation engineers. * Work with the security \& privacy team on retention, access control, consent handling and regional data requirements for vehicle\-collected data. * Set data engineering standards across Autonomy and mentor engineers on schema design, query performance and pipeline reliability. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years in software engineering, with a strong focus on data infrastructure or data platform work. * 5\+ years owning a large\-scale data platform for ML or analytics workloads, including its storage and access model, not only the pipelines on top of it. * 5\+ years with columnar and analytical stores (ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid, BigQuery, Databricks or Snowflake), including data modeling for high\-cardinality data and query performance tuning. * 3\+ years designing storage and query layers for large volumes of heterogeneous metrics, such as KPIs or performance telemetry, where diversity is as hard a problem as volume. * 3\+ years with document or NoSQL stores: schema design, indexing strategy, sharding and the operational realities at scale. * 3\+ years with modern data and table formats (Parquet, Arrow, Iceberg, Delta), with clear reasoning about when each applies. * 3\+ years building batch and streaming pipelines at scale with production orchestration and real data quality gates. * 3\+ years hands\-on with Python, plus production experience in Go, C\+\+ or Rust for performance\-sensitive parts of an access layer. * 3\+ years with queueing and event\-driven systems (SQS, Kafka, Kinesis or equivalent) in a production ingest path. * 2\+ years with production monitoring and alerting for data pipelines (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or CloudWatch), including automated integrity and freshness checks. * 2\+ years migrating a production data platform between storage or format architectures incrementally, while it stayed in service. * Engineering leadership: setting technical vision, timelines and priorities for a project or team, acting as technical lead, and mentoring engineers. * Ability to turn ambiguous, high\-level requirements into a detailed system design and drive it to completion unprompted. * Technical excellence: willingness to work through implementation detail, and a record of raising technical standards across a broader engineering organization. * A record of designing schemas and interfaces that other teams built on and that survived changing requirements. * Nice to have: applied ML for data problems, such as data mining, active learning or embedding\-based retrieval for rare and long\-tail scenarios. * Nice to have: robotics or AV data experience, including ROS/ROS 2, MCAP, rosbag and time synchronization across sensor modalities. * Nice to have: vector databases and embedding\-based retrieval for data mining and scenario discovery. * Nice to have: ML training data pipeline performance, including dataloader throughput, sharding and shuffling. * Nice to have: feature stores, data catalogs or lineage systems.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: SFEG Corp. As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best. Title: Mechanical Design Engineer Type: Full\-Time Location: On\-Site Reporting: Position Reports to the Director of Engineering We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join our highly skilled engineering team. The Mechanical Design Engineer will be responsible for designing and sustaining electromechanical product lines that service multiple industries, which include marine, RV, electric motors, as well as lighting and signs. A few of the many products include electric drive motors, electric blowers, winches, jacks, transformers, and more. The diversity of marketplaces and product lines creates an exciting and ever\-changing environment for the Mechanical Design Engineer to display their expertise and design skillset. The Mechanical Design Engineer will be equipped with all the necessary tools required to perform the job at a high level. For engineering design, SolidWorks is used for all 3D modeling and detailing efforts. In addition, access to various types of simulation software (FEA, CFD, etc.) is made available when required by the project. An ERP system is used to control all bills of materials and item masters. The Mechanical Design Engineer will have access to a fully furnished engineering lab and machine shop to support product design and prototyping. Most importantly, the Mechanical Design Engineer will have great support from an experienced and highly skilled engineering team. The engineer that excels in this position will be an individual of high work ethic and character, is self\-motivated, can operate under minimal supervision, maintains close attention to detail, and embodies exceptional organization and communication skills. **Expectations:** * Work collaboratively within an engineering team of mechanical, electrical, and firmware engineers to design new products and upkeep existing product lines. * Work with the Director of Engineering and representatives from Sales \& Marketing to accurately capture product requirements and translate those requirements into a marketable design concept. * Research and understand applicable design and agency standards as required. * Engineer and support new product designs from initial concept to manufacturing implementation. * Utilize SolidWorks daily for all engineering efforts. * Oversee and upkeep product BOM’s and item master’s within the ERP system. * Implement knowledge of various manufacturing processes including CNC machining, stamping, injection molding, die casting, and more to create products that are designed for manufacturability. * Clearly communicate and collaborate with various members of the purchasing team to assist in sourcing manufacturing components. * Provide detailed design presentations. * Build functional prototypes of new or improved designs as proof of concept before implementation. Prototypes are most commonly made from 3D printed and CNC machined components. * Test prototypes and production representative designs to ensure viability before releasing for production. * Analyze test results and ensure compliance with all deliverables and standards. * Oversee the production ramp\-up and ensure design manufacturability. * Participate in the New Product Development Phase Gate process as well as the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) process. * Other duties as required. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline * Minimum 4 years of relevant experience * 3D modeling proficiency in SolidWorks or comparable CAD software * Drafting proficiency * Strong technical skills and understanding of engineering principles * Punctuality and work ethic * Hands\-on mechanical aptitude **Preferred Qualifications:** * Solid understanding of GD\&T * Knowledge of manufacturing processes including injection molding, CNC machining, die casting, and sheet metal fabrication * Experience with 3D printing * Experience with various hand tools and lab equipment such as power tools, soldering equipment, measurement devices, dynamometers, etc. * Experience in medium to high volume manufacturing * Some understanding of motors and electronics **Why Join MPS?** Marmon Power Systems is a subsidiary of Marmon Holdings, Inc., a Berkshire Hathaway company, comprised of 11 industry groups, 30,000 team members, and more than 120 autonomous businesses with a total annual revenue of $12 billion. At MPS, you will find motivated and committed colleagues that work together in a collaborative environment. All departments make it a priority to work together as a cohesive team. The work environment is both cooperative and dynamic. You will be encouraged to share your innovative ideas, and you will find support for your development. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, and opportunities for personal development and growth.
